creator: default
detail_en: Client certificate authentication should not be used for users (Manual)
detail_zh: 用户不应使用客户端证书身份验证（手动）
remediation_en:
Alternative mechanisms provided by Kubernetes such as the use of OIDC should be
implemented in place of client certificates.
remediation_zh: Kubernetes提供的替代机制（如使用OIDC）应该代替客户机证书来实现。

extraDetail.description: Kubernetes 提供了使用客户端证书进行用户身份验证的选项。但是，由于当用户离开组织或丢失其凭据时无法撤销这些证书，因此它们不适合此目的。无法完全禁用集群内的客户端证书使用，因为它用于组件到组件验证。
extraDetail.rationale: 对于任何身份验证机制，如果凭证被泄露或不再需要，撤销凭证的能力是关键控制。由于缺乏对证书吊销的支持，Kubernetes 客户端证书身份验证不允许这样做。
extraDetail.audit: 查看用户对集群的访问权限，并确保用户没有使用 Kubernetes 客户端证书身份验证。
extraDetail.remediation: Kubernetes 提供的替代机制（例如使用 OIDC）应代替客户端证书实施。
extraDetail.impact: 用于身份验证的外部机制通常需要部署额外的软件。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下启用客户端证书身份验证。
extraDetail.description_en: Kubernetes provides the option to use client certificates for user authentication. However as there is no way to revoke these certificates when a user leaves an organization or loses their credential, they are not suitable for this purpose. It is not possible to fully disable client certificate use within a cluster as it is used for component to component authentication.
extraDetail.rationale_en: With any authentication mechanism the ability to revoke credentials if they are compromised or no longer required, is a key control. Kubernetes client certificate authentication does not allow for this due to a lack of support for certificate revocation.
extraDetail.audit_en: Review user access to the cluster and ensure that users are not making use of Kubernetes client certificate authentication.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Alternative mechanisms provided by Kubernetes such as the use of OIDC should be implemented in place of client certificates.
extraDetail.impact_en: External mechanisms for authentication generally require additional software to be deployed.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: Client certificate authentication is enabled by default. Additional Information: The lack of certificate revocation was flagged up as a high risk issue in the recent Kubernetes security audit. Without this feature, client certificate authentication is not suitable for end users.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that a minimal audit policy is created (Manual)
detail_zh: 确保创建了最小授权策略（手动）
remediation_en: Create an audit policy file for your cluster.
remediation_zh: 为集群创建审核策略文件。

extraDetail.description: Kubernetes 可以审计向 API Server 发出的请求的详细信息。必须设置 --audit-policy-file 标志才能启用此日志记录。
extraDetail.rationale: 日志记录是所有系统的重要检测控制，用于检测潜在的未经授权的访问。
extraDetail.audit:
在集群 master 节点之一上运行以下命令：
ps -ef | grep kube-apiserver

验证是否设置了 --audit-policy-file。查看指定文件的内容并确保它包含有效的审计策略。
extraDetail.remediation: 为您的集群创建一个审计策略文件。
extraDetail.impact: 审计日志将在 master 节点上创建，这将消耗磁盘空间。应注意避免生成过多的日志信息，因为这可能会影响集群节点的可用性。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 除非指定 --audit-policy-file 标志，否则不会执行审计。
extraDetail.description_en: Kubernetes can audit the details of requests made to the API server. The --audit-policy-file flag must be set for this logging to be enabled.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Logging is an important detective control for all systems, to detect potential unauthorised access.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command on one of the cluster master nodes: ps -ef | grep kube-apiserver Verify that the --audit-policy-file is set. Review the contents of the file specified and ensure that it contains a valid audit policy.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Create an audit policy file for your cluster.
extraDetail.impact_en: Audit logs will be created on the master nodes, which will consume disk space. Care should be taken to avoid generating too large volumes of log information as this could impact the available of the cluster nodes.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: Unless the --audit-policy-file flag is specified, no auditing will be carried out.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the audit policy covers key security concerns (Manual)
detail_zh: 确保审核策略涵盖关键安全问题（手动）
remediation_en:
Consider modification of the audit policy in use on the cluster to include these items, at a
minimum.
remediation_zh: 考虑修改集群上正在使用的审核策略，以至少包括这些项。

extraDetail.description: 确保为集群创建的审计策略涵盖关键安全问题。
extraDetail.rationale: 安全审计日志应涵盖集群中关键资源的访问和修改，使它们成为安全环境的有效组成部分。
extraDetail.audit:
查看为集群提供的审计策略并确保它至少涵盖以下领域：
1. 对集群管理的机密的访问。应注意仅记录对 Secrets、ConfigMaps 和 TokenReviews 的请求的元数据，以避免记录敏感数据的风险。
2. 修改 pod 和部署对象。
3. 使用 pods/exec、pods/portforward、pods/proxy 和服务/proxy。
对于大多数请求，建议在元数据级别进行最低限度的日志记录（最基本的日志记录级别）。
extraDetail.remediation: 考虑修改集群上使用的审计策略以至少包括这些项目。
extraDetail.impact: 增加审计日志将消耗节点或其他日志目标上的资源。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，Kubernetes 集群不记录审计信息。
extraDetail.description_en: Ensure that the audit policy created for the cluster covers key security concerns.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Security audit logs should cover access and modification of key resources in the cluster, to enable them to form an effective part of a security environment.
extraDetail.audit_en: Review the audit policy provided for the cluster and ensure that it covers at least the following areas :- • Access to Secrets managed by the cluster. Care should be taken to only log Metadata for requests to Secrets, ConfigMaps, and TokenReviews, in order to avoid the risk of logging sensitive data. • Modification of pod and deployment objects. • Use of pods/exec, pods/portforward, pods/proxy and services/proxy. For most requests, minimally logging at the Metadata level is recommended (the most basic level of logging).
extraDetail.remediation_en: Consider modification of the audit policy in use on the cluster to include these items, at a minimum.
extraDetail.impact_en: Increasing audit logging will consume resources on the nodes or other log destination.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default Kubernetes clusters do not log audit information.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the --cert-file and --key-file arguments are set as appropriate (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保--cert-file和--key-file参数设置为适当的（自动）
remediation_en:
Follow the etcd service documentation and configure TLS encryption.
Then, edit the etcd pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/etcd.yaml
on the master node and set the below parameters.
--cert-file=</path/to/ca-file>
--key-file=</path/to/key-file>
remediation_zh:
遵循etcd服务文档并配置TLSencryption.然后，在master节点编辑etcd pod规范文件
/etc/kubernetes/manifests/etcd.yaml并设置以下参数。
--cert-file=</path/to/ca-file>
--key-file=</path/to/key-file>

extraDetail.description: 为 etcd 服务配置 TLS 加密。
extraDetail.rationale: Etcd是一个高可用性的键值存储，被Kubernetes部署用于持久性存储其所有的REST API对象。这些对象的性质很敏感，应该在传输过程中进行加密。
extraDetail.audit: 在etcd服务节点上运行以下命令：ps -ef | grep etcd。验证 --cert-file 和 --key-file 参数是否设置得当。
extraDetail.remediation:
按照etcd服务文档，配置TLS加密。然后，在master节点上编辑etcd 的 pod规范文件/etc/kubernetes/manifests/etcd.yaml，并设置以下参数。
--cert-file=</path/to/ca-file>
--key-file=</path/to/key-file>
extraDetail.impact: 只有通过TLS的客户连接才会得到服务。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，未设置 TLS 加密。
extraDetail.description_en: Configure TLS encryption for the etcd service.
extraDetail.rationale_en: etcd is a highly-available key value store used by Kubernetes deployments for persistent storage of all of its REST API objects. These objects are sensitive in nature and should be encrypted in transit.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command on the etcd server node ps -ef | grep etcd Verify that the --cert-file and the --key-file arguments are set as appropriate.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Follow the etcd service documentation and configure TLS encryption. Then, edit the etcd pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/etcd.yaml on the master node and set the below parameters. --cert-file=</path/to/ca-file> --key-file=</path/to/key-file>
extraDetail.impact_en: Client connections only over TLS would be served.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, TLS encryption is not set.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the --client-cert-auth argument is set to true (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保--client-cert-auth参数设置为true（自动）
remediation_en:
Edit the etcd pod specification file $etcdconf on the master
node and set the below parameter.
--client-cert-auth="true"
remediation_zh:
在主节点上编辑etcd pod规范文件$etcdconf并设置以下参数。
--client-cert-auth="true"

extraDetail.description: 在 etcd 服务上启用客户端身份验证。
extraDetail.rationale: Etcd是一个高可用的键值存储，被Kubernetes部署用于持久化存储其所有的REST API对象。这些对象本质上是敏感的，不应提供给未经身份验证的客户端。您应该通过有效证书启用客户端身份验证，以保护对 etcd 服务的访问。
extraDetail.audit: 在 etcd 服务器节点上运行以下命令：ps -ef | grep etcd。验证 --client-cert-auth 参数是否设置为 true。
extraDetail.remediation:
编辑master节点上的 etcd pod 规范文件 /etc/kubernetes/manifests/etcd.yaml 并设置以下参数：
--client-cert-auth="true"
extraDetail.impact: 所有尝试访问 etcd 服务器的客户端都需要有效的客户端证书。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，etcd服务可以被未经认证的客户端查询。
extraDetail.description_en: Enable client authentication on etcd service.
extraDetail.rationale_en: etcd is a highly-available key value store used by Kubernetes deployments for persistent storage of all of its REST API objects. These objects are sensitive in nature and should not be available to unauthenticated clients. You should enable the client authentication via valid certificates to secure the access to the etcd service.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command on the etcd server node: ps -ef | grep etcd Verify that the --client-cert-auth argument is set to true.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Edit the etcd pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/etcd.yaml on the master node and set the below parameter. --client-cert-auth="true"
extraDetail.impact_en: All clients attempting to access the etcd server will require a valid client certificate.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, the etcd service can be queried by unauthenticated clients.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the --auto-tls argument is not set to true (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保--auto-tls参数未设置为true（自动）
remediation_en:
Edit the etcd pod specification file $etcdconf on the master
node and either remove the --auto-tls parameter or set it to false.
  --auto-tls=false
remediation_zh:
在master节点上编辑etcd pod规范文件$etcdconf，并删除--auto-tls参数或将其设置为false。
  --auto-tls=false

extraDetail.description: 不要将自签名证书用于 TLS。
extraDetail.rationale: Etcd是一个高可用的键值存储，被Kubernetes部署用于持久化存储其所有的REST API对象。这些对象本质上是敏感的，不应提供给未经认证的客户端。你应该通过有效的证书启用客户端认证，以确保对etcd服务的访问。
extraDetail.audit: 在etcd节点运行下面的命令：ps -ef | grep etcd。确认如果存在 --auto-tls 参数，它是否被设置为 true。
extraDetail.remediation: 在master节点上编辑etcd pod规范文件/etc/kubernetes/manifests/etcd.yaml，删除--auto-tls参数或将其设为false。
extraDetail.impact: 客户端将不能使用TLS的自签名证书。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，--auto-tls 设置为 false。
extraDetail.description_en: Do not use self-signed certificates for TLS.
extraDetail.rationale_en: etcd is a highly-available key value store used by Kubernetes deployments for persistent storage of all of its REST API objects. These objects are sensitive in nature and should not be available to unauthenticated clients. You should enable the client authentication via valid certificates to secure the access to the etcd service.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command on the etcd server node: ps -ef | grep etcd Verify that if the --auto-tls argument exists, it is not set to true.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Edit the etcd pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/etcd.yaml on the master node and either remove the --auto-tls parameter or set it to false. --auto-tls=false
extraDetail.impact_en: Clients will not be able to use self-signed certificates for TLS.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, --auto-tls is set to false.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the --peer-cert-file and --peer-key-file arguments are set as appropriate (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保--peer-cert-file和--peer-key-file参数设置为适当的（自动）
remediation_en:
Follow the etcd service documentation and configure peer TLS encryption as appropriate
for your etcd cluster.
Then, edit the etcd pod specification file $etcdconf on the
master node and set the below parameters.
--peer-client-file=</path/to/peer-cert-file>
--peer-key-file=</path/to/peer-key-file>
remediation_zh:
遵循etcd服务文档，并根据您的etcd配置对等TLS加密cluster.
然后，编辑主节点上的etcd pod规范文件$etcdconf并设置以下参数。
--peer-client-file=</path/to/peer-cert-file>
--peer-key-file=</path/to/peer-key-file>

extraDetail.description: Etcd 应配置为使用 TLS 加密进行节点间连接。
extraDetail.rationale: Etcd是一个高可用的键值存储，被Kubernetes部署用于持久化存储其所有的REST API对象。这些对象本质上是敏感的，应该在 etcd 集群中的节点之间的传输过程中进行加密。
extraDetail.audit:
此建议仅适用于 etcd 集群。如果您在您的环境中仅使用一个 etcd 服务器，则此建议不适用。
在 etcd 节点上运行以下命令：
ps -ef | grep etcd

检查 --peer-cert-file and --peer-key-file 参数是否被设置为合适的值。
extraDetail.remediation:
遵循 etcd 服务文档并根据您的 etcd 集群配置对等 TLS 加密。然后，编辑 master
 节点上的 etcd pod 规范文件 /etc/kubernetes/manifests/etcd.yaml 并设置以下参数：
--peer-cert-file=</path/to/peer-cert-file> 
--peer-key-file=</path/to/peer-key-file>
extraDetail.impact: Etcd 集群需要为节点间的通信设置 TLS。
extraDetail.defaultValue:
注意：此建议仅适用于 etcd 集群。如果您在您的环境中仅使用一个 etcd 服务器，则此建议不适用。
默认情况下，未配置基于 TLS 的节点间通信。
extraDetail.description_en: etcd should be configured to make use of TLS encryption for peer connections.
extraDetail.rationale_en: etcd is a highly-available key value store used by Kubernetes deployments for persistent storage of all of its REST API objects. These objects are sensitive in nature and should be encrypted in transit and also amongst peers in the etcd clusters.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command on the etcd server node: ps -ef | grep etcd Verify that the --peer-cert-file and --peer-key-file arguments are set as appropriate. Note: This recommendation is applicable only for etcd clusters. If you are using only one etcd server in your environment then this recommendation is not applicable.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Follow the etcd service documentation and configure peer TLS encryption as appropriate for your etcd cluster. Then, edit the etcd pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/etcd.yaml on the master node and set the below parameters. --peer-client-file=</path/to/peer-cert-file> --peer-key-file=</path/to/peer-key-file>
extraDetail.impact_en: etcd cluster peers would need to set up TLS for their communication.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: Note: This recommendation is applicable only for etcd clusters. If you are using only one etcd server in your environment then this recommendation is not applicable. By default, peer communication over TLS is not configured.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the --peer-client-cert-auth argument is set to true (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保--peer-client-cert-auth参数设置为true（自动）
remediation_en:
Edit the etcd pod specification file $etcdconf on the master
node and set the below parameter.
--peer-client-cert-auth=true
remediation_zh:
在主节点上编辑etcd pod规范文件$etcdconf并设置以下参数。
--peer-client-cert-auth=true

extraDetail.description: Etcd应该配置节点间认证。
extraDetail.rationale: Etcd是一个高可用的键值存储，被Kubernetes部署用于持久化存储其所有的REST API对象。这些对象本质上是敏感的，只能由 etcd 集群中经过身份验证的 etcd 节点访问。
extraDetail.audit:
此建议仅适用于 etcd 集群。如果您在您的环境中仅使用一个 etcd 服务器，则此建议不适用。
在 etcd 节点上运行以下命令：
ps -ef | grep etcd

检查 --peer-client-cert-auth 参数是否被设置为 true。
extraDetail.remediation:
编辑master节点上的 etcd pod 规范文件 /etc/kubernetes/manifests/etcd.yaml 并设置以下参数：
--peer-client-cert-auth=true
extraDetail.impact: 所有尝试与 etcd 其它节点通信都需要有效的客户端证书进行身份验证。
extraDetail.defaultValue:
注意：此建议仅适用于 etcd 集群。如果您在您的环境中仅使用一个 etcd 服务器，则此建议不适用。
默认情况下，--peer-client-cert-auth 参数设置为 false。
extraDetail.description_en: etcd should be configured for peer authentication.
extraDetail.rationale_en: etcd is a highly-available key value store used by Kubernetes deployments for persistent storage of all of its REST API objects. These objects are sensitive in nature and should be accessible only by authenticated etcd peers in the etcd cluster.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command on the etcd server node: ps -ef | grep etcd Verify that the --peer-client-cert-auth argument is set to true. Note: This recommendation is applicable only for etcd clusters. If you are using only one etcd server in your environment then this recommendation is not applicable.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Edit the etcd pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/etcd.yaml on the master node and set the below parameter. --peer-client-cert-auth=true
extraDetail.impact_en: All peers attempting to communicate with the etcd server will require a valid client certificate for authentication.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: Note: This recommendation is applicable only for etcd clusters. If you are using only one etcd server in your environment then this recommendation is not applicable. By default, --peer-client-cert-auth argument is set to false.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the --peer-auto-tls argument is not set to true (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保--peer-auto-tls参数未被设置为true（Automated）
remediation_en:
Edit the etcd pod specification file $etcdconf on the master
node and either remove the --peer-auto-tls parameter or set it to false.
--peer-auto-tls=false
remediation_zh:
在主节点上编辑etcd pod规范文件$etcdconf，并删除--peer-auto-tls参数或将其设置为false。
--peer-auto-tls=false

extraDetail.description: 不要将自动生成的自签名证书用于ETCD节点之间的 TLS 连接。
extraDetail.rationale: Etcd是一个高可用的键值存储，被Kubernetes部署用于持久化存储其所有的REST API对象。这些对象本质上是敏感的，只能由 etcd 集群中经过身份验证的 etcd 节点访问。因此，请勿使用自签名证书进行身份验证。
extraDetail.audit:
此建议仅适用于 etcd 集群。如果您在您的环境中仅使用一个 etcd 服务器，则此建议不适用。
在 etcd 节点上运行以下命令：
ps -ef | grep etcd

检查 --peer-auto-tls 是否存在，它是否设置为 true。
extraDetail.remediation:
编辑主节点上的 etcd pod 规范文件 /etc/kubernetes/manifests/etcd.yaml 并删除 --peer-auto-tls 参数或将其设置为 false。
--peer-auto-tls=false
extraDetail.impact: 所有尝试与 etcd 服务器通信的etcd节点都需要有效的客户端证书进行身份验证。
extraDetail.defaultValue:
注意：此建议仅适用于 etcd 集群。如果您在您的环境中仅使用一个 etcd 服务器，则此建议不适用。
默认情况下，--peer-auto-tls 参数设置为 false。
extraDetail.description_en: Do not use automatically generated self-signed certificates for TLS connections between peers.
extraDetail.rationale_en: etcd is a highly-available key value store used by Kubernetes deployments for persistent storage of all of its REST API objects. These objects are sensitive in nature and should be accessible only by authenticated etcd peers in the etcd cluster. Hence, do not use self-signed certificates for authentication.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command on the etcd server node: ps -ef | grep etcd Verify that if the --peer-auto-tls argument exists, it is not set to true. Note: This recommendation is applicable only for etcd clusters. If you are using only one etcd server in your environment then this recommendation is not applicable.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Edit the etcd pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/etcd.yaml on the master node and either remove the --peer-auto-tls parameter or set it to false. --peer-auto-tls=false
extraDetail.impact_en: All peers attempting to communicate with the etcd server will require a valid client certificate for authentication.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: Note: This recommendation is applicable only for etcd clusters. If you are using only one etcd server in your environment then this recommendation is not applicable. By default, --peer-auto-tls argument is set to false.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that a unique Certificate Authority is used for etcd (Manual)
detail_zh: 确保etcd使用唯一的证书授权（手动）
remediation_en:
[Manual test]
Follow the etcd documentation and create a dedicated certificate authority setup for the
etcd service.
Then, edit the etcd pod specification file $etcdconf on the
master node and set the below parameter.
--trusted-ca-file=</path/to/ca-file>
remediation_zh:
[手动测试]
遵循etcd文档，为etcd服务创建专用的证书授权设置。
然后，在主节点上编辑etcd pod规范文件$etcdconf并设置以下参数。
--trusted-ca-file=</path/to/ca-file>

extraDetail.description: 对 etcd 使用与 Kubernetes 不同的证书颁发机构。
extraDetail.rationale: etcd 是 Kubernetes 部署使用的高可用键值存储，用于持久存储其所有 REST API 对象。它的访问权限应仅限于特定指定的客户端和对等方。对 etcd 的身份验证基于所提供的证书是否由受信任的证书颁发机构颁发。不检查证书属性，例如公用名或主题备用名称。因此，如果任何攻击者能够访问受信任的证书颁发机构颁发的任何证书，他们将能够获得对 etcd 数据库的完全访问权限。
extraDetail.audit:
查看 etcd 环境使用的 CA，确保它与用于管理整个 Kubernetes 集群的 CA 证书文件不匹配。在主节点上运行以下命令：
ps -ef | grep etcd

注意 --trusted-ca-fileargument 引用的文件。在主节点上运行以下命令：
ps -ef | grep apiserver

验证 --client-ca-filefor apiserver 引用的文件是否与 etcd 使用的 --trusted-ca-file 不同。
extraDetail.remediation:
按照 etcd 文档为 etcd 服务创建一个专用的证书颁发机构设置。然后，编辑 etcd pod 规范文件 /etc/kubernetes/manifests/etcd.yaml。在主节点上并设置以下参数。
--trusted-ca-file=</path/to/ca-file>
extraDetail.impact: 需要对专用证书颁发机构的证书和密钥进行额外管理。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，不会创建和使用 etcd 证书。
extraDetail.description_en: Use a different certificate authority for etcd from the one used for Kubernetes.
extraDetail.rationale_en: etcd is a highly available key-value store used by Kubernetes deployments for persistent storage of all of its REST API objects. Its access should be restricted to specifically designated clients and peers only. Authentication to etcd is based on whether the certificate presented was issued by a trusted certificate authority. There is no checking of certificate attributes such as common name or subject alternative name. As such, if any attackers were able to gain access to any certificate issued by the trusted certificate authority, they would be able to gain full access to the etcd database.
extraDetail.audit_en: Review the CA used by the etcd environment and ensure that it does not match the CA certificate file used for the management of the overall Kubernetes cluster. Run the following command on the master node: ps -ef | grep etcd Note the file referenced by the --trusted-ca-file argument. Run the following command on the master node: ps -ef | grep apiserver Verify that the file referenced by the --client-ca-file for apiserver is different from the --trusted-ca-file used by etcd.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Follow the etcd documentation and create a dedicated certificate authority setup for the etcd service. Then, edit the etcd pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/etcd.yaml on the master node and set the below parameter. --trusted-ca-file=</path/to/ca-file>
extraDetail.impact_en: Additional management of the certificates and keys for the dedicated certificate authority will be required.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, no etcd certificate is created and used.

chmod -R 600 /etc/kubernetes/pki/*.key
remediation_zh:
在主节点上运行以下命令（基于系统上的文件位置）。例如，
chmod -R 600 /etc/kubernetes/pki/*.key

extraDetail.description: 确保 Kubernetes PKI 密钥文件具有 600 或更严格的权限。
extraDetail.rationale: Kubernetes 使用许多密钥文件作为其组件操作的一部分。这些文件的权限应设置为 600 或更严格，以保护其完整性。
extraDetail.audit:
在 master 节点上运行以下命令（基于系统上的文件位置）。
find /etc/kubernetes/pki -name "*.key" | xargs stat -c '%n %a'

验证权限是否为 644 或更严格。
extraDetail.remediation:
在 master 节点上运行以下命令（基于系统上的文件位置）。
例如，chmod -R 600 /etc/kubernetes/pki/*.crt
extraDetail.impact: 无。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，Kubernetes 使用的密钥设置为具有 600 的权限
extraDetail.description_en: Ensure that Kubernetes PKI key files have permissions of 600.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Kubernetes makes use of a number of key files as part of the operation of its components. The permissions on these files should be set to 600 to protect their integrity and confidentiality.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the below command (based on the file location on your system) on the Control Plane node. For example, ls -laR /etc/kubernetes/pki/*.key Verify that the permissions are 600.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Run the below command (based on the file location on your system) on the Control Plane node. For example, chmod -R 600 /etc/kubernetes/pki/*.key
extraDetail.impact_en: None
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, the keys used by Kubernetes are set to have permissions of 600

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the --anonymous-auth argument is set to false (Manual)
detail_zh: 确保--anonymous-auth参数设置为false（手动）
remediation_en:
Edit the API server pod specification file $apiserverconf
on the master node and set the below parameter.
--anonymous-auth=false
remediation_zh:
在master节点编辑API服务器pod规范文件$apiserverconf并设置以下参数。
--anonymous-auth=false

extraDetail.description: 禁用对 API 服务器的匿名请求。
extraDetail.rationale: 启用后，其他配置的身份验证方法未拒绝的请求将被视为匿名请求。然后由 API 服务器处理这些请求。您应该依靠身份验证来授权访问并禁止匿名请求。如果您使用 RBAC 授权，通常认为允许匿名访问 API Server 以进行健康检查和发现是合理的，因此此建议不计分。但是，您应该考虑匿名发现是否是您可以接受的风险。
extraDetail.audit:
在控制平面节点上运行以下命令：
ps -ef | grep kube-apiserver

验证 --anonymous-authargument 是否设置为 false。
extraDetail.remediation:
编辑控制平面节点上的 API 服务器 pod 规范文件 /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml 并设置以下参数。
--anonymous-auth=false
extraDetail.impact: 匿名请求将被拒绝。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，启用匿名访问。
extraDetail.description_en: Disable anonymous requests to the Kubelet server.
extraDetail.rationale_en: When enabled, requests that are not rejected by other configured authentication methods are treated as anonymous requests. These requests are then served by the Kubelet server. You should rely on authentication to authorize access and disallow anonymous requests.
extraDetail.audit_en: If using a Kubelet configuration file, check that there is an entry for authentication: anonymous: enabled set to false. Run the following command on each node: ps -ef | grep kubelet Verify that the --anonymous-auth argument is set to false. This executable argument may be omitted, provided there is a corresponding entry set to false in the Kubelet config file.
extraDetail.remediation_en: If using a Kubelet config file, edit the file to set authentication: anonymous: enabled to false. If using executable arguments, edit the kubelet service file /etc/kubernetes/kubelet.conf on each worker node and set the below parameter in KUBELET_SYSTEM_PODS_ARGS variable. --anonymous-auth=false Based on your system, restart the kubelet service. For example: systemctl daemon-reload systemctl restart kubelet.service
extraDetail.impact_en: Anonymous requests will be rejected.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, anonymous access is enabled.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the --basic-auth-file argument is not set (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保未设置--basic-auth-file参数（自动）
remediation_en:
Follow the documentation and configure alternate mechanisms for authentication. Then,
edit the API server pod specification file $apiserverconf
on the master node and remove the --basic-auth-file=<filename> parameter.
remediation_zh:
按照文档操作并配置其他身份验证机制。然后，在master节点编辑API服务器pod规范文件$apiserverconf，
并删除--basic-auth-file=<filename>参数。

extraDetail.description: 不要使用 basic authentication.
extraDetail.rationale: basic authentication 使用明文凭证进行认证。目前，basic authentication的凭证是无限期的，而且如果不重新启动API Server，就不能改变密码。目前支持 basic authentication 是为了方便。因此，不应该使用basic authentication。
extraDetail.audit:
在master节点上运行以下命令：
ps -ef | grep kube-apiserver

验证 --basic-auth-file 参数不存在。
extraDetail.remediation: 按照文档的要求，配置备用的认证机制。然后，在 master 节点上编辑API Server的pod规范文件/etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml，并删除--basic-auth-file=<filename>参数。
extraDetail.impact: 你将不得不配置和使用替代的认证机制，如令牌和证书。不能再使用 basic authentication 的用户名和密码。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下未设置。
extraDetail.description_en: Do not use token based authentication.
extraDetail.rationale_en: The token-based authentication utilizes static tokens to authenticate requests to the apiserver. The tokens are stored in clear-text in a file on the apiserver, and cannot be revoked or rotated without restarting the apiserver. Hence, do not use static token-based authentication.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command on the Control Plane node: ps -ef | grep kube-apiserver Verify that the --token-auth-file argument does not exist.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Follow the documentation and configure alternate mechanisms for authentication. Then, edit the API server pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml on the master node and remove the --token-auth-file=<filename> parameter.
extraDetail.impact_en: You will have to configure and use alternate authentication mechanisms such as certificates. Static token based authentication could not be used.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, --token-auth-file argument is not set.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the --token-auth-file parameter is not set (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保未设置--token-auth-file参数（自动）
remediation_en:
Follow the documentation and configure alternate mechanisms for authentication. Then,
edit the API server pod specification file $apiserverconf
on the master node and remove the --token-auth-file=<filename> parameter.
remediation_zh:
按照文档操作并配置其他身份验证机制。然后，编辑API服务器pod规范文件$apiserverconf，
并删除--token-auth-file=<filename>参数。

extraDetail.description: 不要使用基于令牌的身份验证。

extraDetail.audit:
在 master 节点上运行以下命令：

检查 --token-auth-file 参数是否存在。
extraDetail.remediation: 遵循文档并配置用于身份验证的替代机制。然后，编辑主节点上的 API Server 的 pod 规范文件 /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml 并删除 --token-auth-file=<filename> 参数。
extraDetail.impact: 您将不得不配置和使用替代的身份验证机制，例如证书。无法使用基于静态令牌的身份验证。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，--token-auth-file 参数未设置。
extraDetail.description_en: Do not use token based authentication.
extraDetail.rationale_en: The token-based authentication utilizes static tokens to authenticate requests to the apiserver. The tokens are stored in clear-text in a file on the apiserver, and cannot be revoked or rotated without restarting the apiserver. Hence, do not use static token-based authentication.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command on the Control Plane node: ps -ef | grep kube-apiserver Verify that the --token-auth-file argument does not exist.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Follow the documentation and configure alternate mechanisms for authentication. Then, edit the API server pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml on the master node and remove the --token-auth-file=<filename> parameter.
extraDetail.impact_en: You will have to configure and use alternate authentication mechanisms such as certificates. Static token based authentication could not be used.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, --token-auth-file argument is not set.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the --kubelet-https argument is set to true (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保--kubelet-https参数设置为true（自动）
remediation_en:
Edit the API server pod specification file $apiserverconf
on the master node and remove the --kubelet-https parameter.
remediation_zh: 在master节点编辑API服务器pod规范文件$apiserverconf并删除--kubelet-https参数。

extraDetail.description: 使用 https 进行 kubelet 连接。
extraDetail.rationale: 从 apiserver 到 kubelet 的连接可能会携带敏感数据，例如 secret 和密钥。因此，对 apiserver 和 kubelet 之间的任何通信使用传输中加密非常重要。
extraDetail.audit:
在master节点上运行以下命令：
ps -ef | grep kube-apiserver

检查 --kubelet-https 参数是否存在，或者它的值是否为 true。
extraDetail.remediation: 编辑 master 节点上的 API 服务器 pod 规范文件 /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml 并删除 --kubelet-https 参数。
extraDetail.impact: 您需要在 apiserver 和 kubelets 上配置 TLS。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，kubelet 连接基于 https。
extraDetail.description_en: Enable certificate based kubelet authentication.
extraDetail.rationale_en: The apiserver, by default, does not authenticate itself to the kubelet's HTTPS endpoints. The requests from the apiserver are treated anonymously. You should set up certificate-based kubelet authentication to ensure that the apiserver authenticates itself to kubelets when submitting requests.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command on the Control Plane node: ps -ef | grep kube-apiserver Verify that the --kubelet-client-certificate and --kubelet-client-key arguments exist and they are set as appropriate.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Follow the Kubernetes documentation and set up the TLS connection between the apiserver and kubelets. Then, edit API server pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml on the Control Plane node and set the kubelet client certificate and key parameters as below. --kubelet-client-certificate=<path/to/client-certificate-file> --kubelet-client-key=<path/to/client-key-file>
extraDetail.impact_en: You require TLS to be configured on apiserver as well as kubelets.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, certificate-based kubelet authentication is not set.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the --kubelet-client-certificate and --kubelet-client-key arguments are set as appropriate (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保--kubelet-client-certificate 和 --kubelet-client-key参数设置为适当的（自动）
remediation_en:
Follow the Kubernetes documentation and set up the TLS connection between the
apiserver and kubelets. Then, edit API server pod specification file
$apiserverconf on the master node and set the
kubelet client certificate and key parameters as below.
--kubelet-client-certificate=<path/to/client-certificate-file>
--kubelet-client-key=<path/to/client-key-file>
remediation_zh:
遵循Kubernetes文档并在apiserver和kubelets设置TLS连接。然后，在master节点编辑API服务器pod规范文件$apiserverconf，
并设置kubelet客户端证书和关键参数如下。
--kubelet-client-certificate=<path/to/client-certificate-file>
--kubelet-client-key=<path/to/client-key-file>

extraDetail.description: 启用基于证书的 kubelet 身份验证。
extraDetail.rationale: 默认情况下，apiserver 不对 kubelet 的 HTTPS 端点进行身份验证。来自 apiserver 的请求被匿名处理。您应该设置基于证书的 kubelet 身份验证，以确保 apiserver 在提交请求时向 kubelet 进行身份验证。
extraDetail.audit:
在master节点上运行以下命令：
ps -ef | grep kube-apiserver

检查 --kubelet-client-certificate 和 --kubelet-client-key 参数是否存在，且它们被设置为合适的值。
extraDetail.remediation:
按照 Kubernetes 文档设置 apiserver 和 kubelets 之间的 TLS 连接。然后，在主节点上编辑 API server pod 规范文件 /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml ，并设置 kubelet 客户端证书和密钥参数，如下所示。
--kubelet-client-certificate=<path/to/client-certificate-file> 
--kubelet-client-key=<path/to/client-key-file>
extraDetail.impact: 您需要在 apiserver 和 kubelets 上配置 TLS。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，未设置基于证书的 kubelet 身份验证。
extraDetail.description_en: Enable certificate based kubelet authentication.
extraDetail.rationale_en: The apiserver, by default, does not authenticate itself to the kubelet's HTTPS endpoints. The requests from the apiserver are treated anonymously. You should set up certificate-based kubelet authentication to ensure that the apiserver authenticates itself to kubelets when submitting requests.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command on the Control Plane node: ps -ef | grep kube-apiserver Verify that the --kubelet-client-certificate and --kubelet-client-key arguments exist and they are set as appropriate.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Follow the Kubernetes documentation and set up the TLS connection between the apiserver and kubelets. Then, edit API server pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml on the Control Plane node and set the kubelet client certificate and key parameters as below. --kubelet-client-certificate=<path/to/client-certificate-file> --kubelet-client-key=<path/to/client-key-file>
extraDetail.impact_en: You require TLS to be configured on apiserver as well as kubelets.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, certificate-based kubelet authentication is not set.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the --kubelet-certificate-authority argument is set as appropriate (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保将--kubelet-certificate-authority参数设置为适当的（自动）
remediation_en:
Follow the Kubernetes documentation and setup the TLS connection between
the apiserver and kubelets. Then, edit the API server pod specification file
$apiserverconf on the master node and set the
--kubelet-certificate-authority parameter to the path to the cert file for the certificate authority.
--kubelet-certificate-authority=<ca-string>
remediation_zh:
遵循Kubernetes文档并在apiserver和kubelets设置TLS连接。然后，在master节点编辑API服务器pod规范文件$apiserverconf并设置
--kubelet-certificate-authority 参数指向证书颁发机构的证书文件的路径。
--kubelet-certificate-authority=<ca-string>

extraDetail.description: 在建立连接之前验证 kubelet 的证书。
extraDetail.rationale: 从 apiserver 到 kubelet 的连接用于获取 pod 的日志、附加（通过 kubectl）到正在运行的 pod，以及使用 kubelets 端口转发功能。这些连接终止于 kubelets HTTPS 端点。默认情况下，apiserver 不验证 kubelets 服务证书，这使得连接受到中间人攻击，并且在不受信任和/或公共网络上运行是不安全的。
extraDetail.audit:
在master节点上运行以下命令：
ps -ef | grep kube-apiserver

检查 --kubelet-certificate-authority 参数是否存在且被设置为合适的值。
extraDetail.remediation:
按照 Kubernetes 文档设置 apiserver 和 kubelets 之间的 TLS 连接。然后，编辑主节点上的 API 服务器 pod 规范文件 /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml 并将 --kubelet-certificate-authority 参数设置为证书颁发机构的证书文件的路径：
--kubelet-certificate-authority=<ca-string>
extraDetail.impact: 您需要在 apiserver 和 kubelets 上配置 TLS。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，--kubelet-certificate-authority 参数未设置。
extraDetail.description_en: Verify kubelet's certificate before establishing connection.
extraDetail.rationale_en: The connections from the apiserver to the kubelet are used for fetching logs for pods, attaching (through kubectl) to running pods, and using the kubelet’s port-forwarding functionality. These connections terminate at the kubelet’s HTTPS endpoint. By default, the apiserver does not verify the kubelet’s serving certificate, which makes the connection subject to man-in-the-middle attacks, and unsafe to run over untrusted and/or public networks.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command on the Control Plane node: ps -ef | grep kube-apiserver Verify that the --kubelet-certificate-authority argument exists and is set as appropriate.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Follow the Kubernetes documentation and setup the TLS connection between the apiserver and kubelets. Then, edit the API server pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml on the Control Plane node and set the --kubelet-certificate-authority parameter to the path to the cert file for the certificate authority. --kubelet-certificate-authority=<ca-string>
extraDetail.impact_en: You require TLS to be configured on apiserver as well as kubelets.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, --kubelet-certificate-authority argument is not set.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the --authorization-mode argument is not set to AlwaysAllow (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保--authorization-mode参数未设置为AlwaysAllow（自动）
remediation_en:
Edit the API server pod specification file $apiserverconf
on the master node and set the --authorization-mode parameter to values other than AlwaysAllow.
One such example could be as below.
--authorization-mode=RBAC
remediation_zh:
在master节点编辑API服务器pod规范文件$apiserverconf，并将--authorization-mode参数设置为AlwaysAllow以外的值。如下：
--authorization-mode=RBAC

extraDetail.description: 不要总是授权所有请求。
extraDetail.rationale: API Server可以被配置为允许所有的请求。这种模式不应该在任何生产集群上使用。
extraDetail.audit:
master节点上运行以下命令：
ps -ef | grep kube-apiserver

验证 --authorization-mode 参数是否存在且未设置为 AlwaysAllow。
extraDetail.remediation: 在主节点上编辑 API Server 的 pod规范文件 /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml，并将 --authorization-mode 参数设置为非 AlwaysAllow 的其它值，例如：--authorization-mode=Node,RBAC
extraDetail.impact: 只有经过授权的请求才会被处理。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，AlwaysAllow 未被启用。
extraDetail.description_en: Do not allow all requests. Enable explicit authorization.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Kubelets, by default, allow all authenticated requests (even anonymous ones) without needing explicit authorization checks from the apiserver. You should restrict this behavior and only allow explicitly authorized requests.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command on each node: ps -ef | grep kubelet If the --authorization-mode argument is present check that it is not set to AlwaysAllow. If it is not present check that there is a Kubelet config file specified by --config, and that file sets authorization: mode to something other than AlwaysAllow. It is also possible to review the running configuration of a Kubelet via the /configz endpoint on the Kubelet API port (typically 10250/TCP). Accessing these with appropriate credentials will provide details of the Kubelet's configuration.
extraDetail.remediation_en: If using a Kubelet config file, edit the file to set authorization: mode to Webhook. If using executable arguments, edit the kubelet service file /etc/kubernetes/kubelet.conf on each worker node and set the below parameter in KUBELET_AUTHZ_ARGS variable. --authorization-mode=Webhook Based on your system, restart the kubelet service. For example: systemctl daemon-reload systemctl restart kubelet.service
extraDetail.impact_en: Unauthorized requests will be denied.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, --authorization-mode argument is set to AlwaysAllow.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the --authorization-mode argument includes Node (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保--authorization-mode参数包含Node（Automated）
remediation_en:
Edit the API server pod specification file $apiserverconf
on the master node and set the --authorization-mode parameter to a value that includes Node.
--authorization-mode=Node,RBAC
remediation_zh:
在master节点编辑API服务器pod规范文件$apiserverconf
并将--authorization-mode参数设置为包含节点的值。
--authorization-mode=Node,RBAC

extraDetail.description: 限制kubelet Node 只读取与之相关的对象。
extraDetail.rationale: Node授权模式只允许kubelets读取与其节点相关的Secret、ConfigMap、PersistentVolume和PersistentVolumeClaim对象。
extraDetail.audit:
在master节点上运行下面的命令：
ps -ef | grep kube-apiserver

验证是否存在 --authorization-mode 参数，并设置为包括 Node 的值。
extraDetail.remediation: 在主节点上编辑 API Server 的 pod规范文件 /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml，并将 --authorization-mode 参数设置为包含Node的值，例如：--authorization-mode=Node,RBAC
extraDetail.impact: 无。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，Node 授权未启用。
extraDetail.description_en: Restrict kubelet nodes to reading only objects associated with them.
extraDetail.rationale_en: The Node authorization mode only allows kubelets to read Secret, ConfigMap, PersistentVolume, and PersistentVolumeClaim objects associated with their nodes.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command on the Control Plane node: ps -ef | grep kube-apiserver Verify that the --authorization-mode argument exists and is set to a value to include Node.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Edit the API server pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml on the Control Plane node and set the --authorization-mode parameter to a value that includes Node. --authorization-mode=Node,RBAC
extraDetail.impact_en: None
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, Node authorization is not enabled.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the --authorization-mode argument includes RBAC (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保--authorization-mode参数包含RBAC（Automated）
remediation_en:
Edit the API server pod specification file $apiserverconf
on the master node and set the --authorization-mode parameter to a value that includes RBAC,
for example:
--authorization-mode=Node,RBAC
remediation_zh:
在master节点编辑API服务器pod规范文件$apiserverconf并将--authorization-mode参数设置为包含RBAC的值，例如：
--authorization-mode=Node,RBAC

extraDetail.description: 开启基于角色的访问控制。
extraDetail.rationale: 基于角色的访问控制（RBAC）允许对不同实体对集群中不同对象的操作进行细粒度的控制。建议使用RBAC授权模式。
extraDetail.audit:
在master节点上运行下面的命令：
ps -ef | grep kube-apiserver

验证是否存在 --authorization-mode 参数，并设置为包括 RBAC 的值。
extraDetail.remediation: 在主节点上编辑 API Server 的 pod规范文件 /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml，并将 --authorization-mode 参数设置为包含 RBAC的值，例如：--authorization-mode=Node,RBAC
extraDetail.impact: 无。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，RBAC 授权未启用。
extraDetail.description_en: Turn on Role Based Access Control.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Role Based Access Control (RBAC) allows fine-grained control over the operations that different entities can perform on different objects in the cluster. It is recommended to use the RBAC authorization mode.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command on the Control Plane node: ps -ef | grep kube-apiserver Verify that the --authorization-mode argument exists and is set to a value to include RBAC.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Edit the API server pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml on the Control Plane node and set the --authorization-mode parameter to a value that includes RBAC, for example: --authorization-mode=Node,RBAC
extraDetail.impact_en: When RBAC is enabled you will need to ensure that appropriate RBAC settings (including Roles, RoleBindings and ClusterRoleBindings) are configured to allow appropriate access.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, RBAC authorization is not enabled.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the admission control plugin EventRateLimit is set (Manual)
detail_zh: 确保已设置准入控制插件EventRateLimit（手动）
remediation_en:
Follow the Kubernetes documentation and set the desired limits in a configuration file.
Then, edit the API server pod specification file $apiserverconf
and set the below parameters.
--enable-admission-plugins=...,EventRateLimit,...
--admission-control-config-file=<path/to/configuration/file>
remediation_zh:
遵循Kubernetes文档并在配置文件中设置所需的限制。然后，编辑API服务器pod规范文件$apiserverconf并设置以下参数。
--enable-admission-plugins=...,EventRateLimit,...
--admission-control-config-file=<path/to/configuration/file>

extraDetail.description: 限制 API 服务器接受请求的速率。
extraDetail.rationale: 使用 EventRateLimitadmission 控件强制限制 API 服务器在给定时间片中将接受的事件数量。行为不端的工作负载可能会使 API Server 不堪重负并执行 DoS，使其不可用。这尤其适用于多租户集群，其中可能存在一小部分行为不端的租户，这可能会对集群的整体性能产生重大影响。因此，建议限制 API 服务器将接受的事件速率。注意：这是 Kubernetes 1.15 版本中的 Alpha 功能。
extraDetail.audit:
在控制平面节点上运行以下命令：
ps -ef | grep kube-apiserver

验证 --enable-admission-pluginsargument 是否设置为包含 EventRateLimit 的值。
extraDetail.remediation:
按照 Kubernetes 文档并在配置文件中设置所需的限制。然后，编辑 API 服务器 pod 规范文件 /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml 并设置以下参数。
--enable-admission-plugins=...,EventRateLimit,...
--admission-control-config-file=<path/to/configuration/file>
extraDetail.impact: 您需要根据您的环境仔细调整限制。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，未设置 EventRateLimitis
extraDetail.description_en: Limit the rate at which the API server accepts requests.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Using EventRateLimit admission control enforces a limit on the number of events that the API Server will accept in a given time slice. A misbehaving workload could overwhelm and DoS the API Server, making it unavailable. This particularly applies to a multi-tenant cluster, where there might be a small percentage of misbehaving tenants which could have a significant impact on the performance of the cluster overall. Hence, it is recommended to limit the rate of events that the API server will accept. Note: This is an Alpha feature in the Kubernetes 1.15 release.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command on the Control Plane node: ps -ef | grep kube-apiserver Verify that the --enable-admission-plugins argument is set to a value that includes EventRateLimit.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Follow the Kubernetes documentation and set the desired limits in a configuration file. Then, edit the API server pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml and set the below parameters. --enable-admission-plugins=...,EventRateLimit,... --admission-control-config-file=<path/to/configuration/file>
extraDetail.impact_en: You need to carefully tune in limits as per your environment.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, EventRateLimit is not set.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the admission control plugin AlwaysAdmit is not set (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保未设置准入控制插件AlwaysAdmin（自动）
remediation_en:
Edit the API server pod specification file $apiserverconf
on the master node and either remove the --enable-admission-plugins parameter, or set it to a
value that does not include AlwaysAdmit.
remediation_zh: 在主节点上编辑API服务器pod规范文件$apiserverconf，删除--enable-admission-plugins参数，或者将其设置为非AlwaysAdmin的其它值。

extraDetail.description: 不允许所有请求。
extraDetail.rationale: 设置准入控制插件 AlwaysAdmit 允许所有请求并且不过滤任何请求。 AlwaysAdmit 准入控制器在 Kubernetes v1.13 中已弃用。它的行为相当于关闭所有准入控制器。
extraDetail.audit:
在master节点上运行下面的命令：
ps -ef | grep kube-apiserver

验证 --enable-admission-plugins 参数的值（如果设置）不包括 AlwaysAdmit。
extraDetail.remediation: 编辑主节点上的 API Server pod 规范文件 /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml 并删除 --enable-admission-plugins 参数，或将其设置为不包含 AlwaysAdmit 的值。
extraDetail.impact: 只有被准入控制插件明确允许的请求才会被处理。
extraDetail.defaultValue: AlwaysAdmit 不在默认准入插件列表中。
extraDetail.description_en: Do not allow all requests.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Setting admission control plugin AlwaysAdmit allows all requests and do not filter any requests. The AlwaysAdmit admission controller was deprecated in Kubernetes v1.13. Its behavior was equivalent to turning off all admission controllers.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command on the Control Plane node: ps -ef | grep kube-apiserver Verify that if the --enable-admission-plugins argument is set, its value does not include AlwaysAdmit.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Edit the API server pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml on the Control Plane node and either remove the --enable-admission-plugins parameter, or set it to a value that does not include AlwaysAdmit.
extraDetail.impact_en: Only requests explicitly allowed by the admissions control plugins would be served.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: AlwaysAdmit is not in the list of default admission plugins.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the admission control plugin AlwaysPullImages is set (Manual)
detail_zh: 确保准入控制插件AlwaysPublimages已设置（手动）
remediation_en:
Edit the API server pod specification file $apiserverconf
on the master node and set the --enable-admission-plugins parameter to include
.
--enable-admission-plugins=...,AlwaysPullImages,...
remediation_zh:
在master节点编辑API服务器pod规范文件$apiserverconf，
并将--enable-admission-plugins参数设置为包含AlwaysPullImages。
--enable-admission-plugins=...,AlwaysPullImages,...

extraDetail.description: 总是拉取镜像。
extraDetail.rationale: 将准入控制策略设置为 AlwaysPullImages 会强制每个新 pod 每次都拉取所需的图像。在多租户集群中，用户可以放心，他们的私有镜像只能由那些拥有提取它们的凭据的人使用。如果没有这个准入控制策略，一旦图像被拉到节点上，任何用户的任何 pod 都可以通过知道图像的名称来使用它，而无需对图像所有权进行任何授权检查。启用此插件后，始终会在启动容器之前拉取映像，这意味着需要有效的凭据。
extraDetail.audit:
在控制平面节点上运行以下命令：
ps -ef | grep kube-apiserver

验证 --enable-admission-plugins 参数是否设置为包含 AlwaysPullImages 的值。
extraDetail.remediation:
编辑控制平面节点上的 API 服务器 pod 规范文件 /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml 并将 --enable-admission-plugins 参数设置为包含 AlwaysPullImages。
--enable-admission-plugins=...,AlwaysPullImages,...
extraDetail.impact: 每次都需要凭证来提取私有图像。此外，在受信任的环境中，这可能会增加网络、注册表的负载并降低速度。此设置可能会影响离线或隔离的集群，这些集群已预先加载了映像并且无权访问注册表以提取正在使用的映像。此设置不适用于使用此配置的集群。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，未设置 AlwaysPullImage。
extraDetail.description_en: Always pull images.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Setting admission control policy to AlwaysPullImages forces every new pod to pull the required images every time. In a multi-tenant cluster users can be assured that their private images can only be used by those who have the credentials to pull them. Without this admission control policy, once an image has been pulled to a node, any pod from any user can use it simply by knowing the image’s name, without any authorization check against the image ownership. When this plug-in is enabled, images are always pulled prior to starting containers, which means valid credentials are required.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command on the Control Plane node: ps -ef | grep kube-apiserver Verify that the --enable-admission-plugins argument is set to a value that includes AlwaysPullImages.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Edit the API server pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml on the Control Plane node and set the --enable-admission-plugins parameter to include AlwaysPullImages. --enable-admission-plugins=...,AlwaysPullImages,...
extraDetail.impact_en: Credentials would be required to pull the private images every time. Also, in trusted environments, this might increases load on network, registry, and decreases speed. This setting could impact offline or isolated clusters, which have images pre-loaded and do not have access to a registry to pull in-use images. This setting is not appropriate for clusters which use this configuration.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, AlwaysPullImages is not set.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the admission control plugin SecurityContextDeny is set if PodSecurityPolicy is not used (Manual)
detail_zh: 如果未使用PodSecurityPolicy，请确保已设置准入控制插件SecurityContextDeny（手动）
remediation_en:
Edit the API server pod specification file $apiserverconf
on the master node and set the --enable-admission-plugins parameter to include
SecurityContextDeny, unless PodSecurityPolicy is already in place.
--enable-admission-plugins=...,SecurityContextDeny,...
remediation_zh:
在master节点编辑API服务器pod规范文件$apiserverconf，并将--enable-admission-plugins参数设置为包含SecurityContextDeny
除非PodSecurityPolicy已设置完成。
--enable-admission-plugins=...,SecurityContextDeny,...

extraDetail.description: SecurityContextDeny 准入控制器可用于拒绝使用某些 SecurityContext 字段的 Pod，这些字段可能允许在集群中进行权限升级。这应该在集群中没有 PodSecurityPolicy 的地方使用。
extraDetail.rationale: SecurityContextDeny 可用于为未启用 PodSecurityPolicies 的集群提供一层安全性。
extraDetail.audit:
在控制平面节点上运行以下命令：
ps -ef | grep kube-apiserver

如果不包含 PodSecurityPolicy，请验证 --enable-admission-plugins 参数是否设置为包含 SecurityContextDeny 的值。
extraDetail.remediation:
编辑 API 服务器 pod 规范文件 /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yamlon 控制平面节点并设置 --enable-admission-plugins 参数以包括 SecurityContextDeny，除非 PodSecurityPolicy 已经到位。
--enable-admission-plugins=...,SecurityContextDeny,...
extraDetail.impact: 此准入控制器应仅在无法在集群上使用 Pod 安全策略的情况下使用，因为它可能与某些 Pod 安全策略交互不良。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，SecurityContextDeny 未设置。
extraDetail.description_en: The SecurityContextDeny admission controller can be used to deny pods which make use of some SecurityContext fields which could allow for privilege escalation in the cluster. This should be used where PodSecurityPolicy is not in place within the cluster.
extraDetail.rationale_en: SecurityContextDeny can be used to provide a layer of security for clusters which do not have PodSecurityPolicies enabled.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command on the Control Plane node: ps -ef | grep kube-apiserver Verify that the --enable-admission-plugins argument is set to a value that includes SecurityContextDeny, if PodSecurityPolicy is not included.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Edit the API server pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml on the Control Plane node and set the --enable-admission-plugins parameter to include SecurityContextDeny, unless PodSecurityPolicy is already in place. --enable-admission-plugins=...,SecurityContextDeny,...
extraDetail.impact_en: This admission controller should only be used where Pod Security Policies cannot be used on the cluster, as it can interact poorly with certain Pod Security Policies
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, SecurityContextDeny is not set.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the admission control plugin ServiceAccount is set (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保准入控制插件ServiceAccount已设置（自动）
remediation_en:
Follow the documentation and create ServiceAccount objects as per your environment.
Then, edit the API server pod specification file $apiserverconf
on the master node and ensure that the --disable-admission-plugins parameter is set to a
value that does not include ServiceAccount.
remediation_zh:
遵循文档并根据您的环境创建ServiceAccount对象。然后，在master节点编辑API服务器pod规范文件$apiserverconf
并确保--disable-admission-plugins参数设置为不包括ServiceAccount的值。

extraDetail.description: 自动化ServiceAccount管理。
extraDetail.rationale: 创建 Pod 时，如果不指定ServiceAccount，则会自动为其分配同一命名空间中的默认ServiceAccount。您应该创建自己的ServiceAccount并让 API Server管理其安全令牌。
extraDetail.audit:
在 master 节点上运行以下命令：
ps -ef | grep kube-apiserver

验证 --disable-admission-plugins 参数是否设置为包含 ServiceAccount 的值。
extraDetail.remediation: 遵循文档并根据您的环境创建 ServiceAccount 对象。然后，在主节点上编辑 API server pod 规范文件 /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml并确保 –disable-admission-plugins 参数设置为不包含 ServiceAccount 的值。
extraDetail.impact: 无。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，ServiceAccount 已设置。
extraDetail.description_en: Automate service accounts management.
extraDetail.rationale_en: When you create a pod, if you do not specify a service account, it is automatically assigned the default service account in the same namespace. You should create your own service account and let the API server manage its security tokens.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command on the Control Plane node: ps -ef | grep kube-apiserver Verify that the --disable-admission-plugins argument is set to a value that does not includes ServiceAccount.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Follow the documentation and create ServiceAccount objects as per your environment. Then, edit the API server pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml on the master node and ensure that the --disable-admission-plugins parameter is set to a value that does not include ServiceAccount.
extraDetail.impact_en: None.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, ServiceAccount is set.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the admission control plugin NamespaceLifecycle is set (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保准入控制插件NamespaceLifecycle已设置（自动）
remediation_en:
Edit the API server pod specification file $apiserverconf
on the master node and set the --disable-admission-plugins parameter to
ensure it does not include NamespaceLifecycle.
remediation_zh:
在master节点编辑API服务器pod规范文件$apiserverconf并设置--disable-admission-plugins参数，
确保它不包括NamespaceLifecycle。

extraDetail.description: 拒绝在正在终止的命名空间中创建对象。
extraDetail.rationale: 将准入控制策略设置为 NamespaceLifecycle 可确保无法在不存在的命名空间中创建对象，并且不会使用正在终止的命名空间来创建新对象。建议这样做以强制命名空间终止过程的完整性，以及更新对象的可用性。
extraDetail.audit:
在master节点上运行下面的命令：
ps -ef | grep kube-apiserver

验证 --disable-admission-plugins 参数是否设置为不包括 NamespaceLifecycle 的值。
extraDetail.remediation: 编辑主节点上的 API server pod 规范文件 /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml 并设置 --disable-admission-plugins 参数以确保它不包含 NamespaceLifecycle。
extraDetail.impact: 无。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，NamespaceLifecycle 已设置。
extraDetail.description_en: Reject creating objects in a namespace that is undergoing termination.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Setting admission control policy to NamespaceLifecycle ensures that objects cannot be created in non-existent namespaces, and that namespaces undergoing termination are not used for creating the new objects. This is recommended to enforce the integrity of the namespace termination process and also for the availability of the newer objects.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command on the Control Plane node: ps -ef | grep kube-apiserver Verify that the --disable-admission-plugins argument is set to a value that does not include NamespaceLifecycle.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Edit the API server pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml on the Control Plane node and set the --disable-admission-plugins parameter to ensure it does not include NamespaceLifecycle.
extraDetail.impact_en: None
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, NamespaceLifecycle is set.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the admission control plugin PodSecurityPolicy is set (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保准入控制插件PodSecurityPolicy已设置（自动）
remediation_en:
Follow the documentation and create Pod Security Policy objects as per your environment.
Then, edit the API server pod specification file $apiserverconf
on the master node and set the --enable-admission-plugins parameter to a
value that includes PodSecurityPolicy:
--enable-admission-plugins=...,PodSecurityPolicy,...
Then restart the API Server.
remediation_zh:
遵循文档并根据您的环境创建Pod安全策略对象。然后，在master节点编辑API服务器pod规范文件$apiserverconf
并将--enable-admission-plugins参数设置为包含PodSecurityPolicy的值：
--enable-admission-plugins=...,PodSecurityPolicy,...
然后重启api服务。

extraDetail.description: 拒绝创建与 Pod 安全策略不匹配的 Pod。
extraDetail.rationale: Pod 安全策略是集群级别的资源，用于控制 pod 可以执行的操作以及它可以访问的内容。 PodSecurityPolicy 对象定义了一组条件，Pod 必须满足这些条件才能被系统接受。 Pod 安全策略由控制 pod 可以访问的安全功能的设置和策略组成，因此必须使用它来控制 pod 访问权限。注意：当 PodSecurityPolicy 准入插件在使用中时，需要至少有一个 PodSecurityPolicy 以允许任何 pod 被准入。
extraDetail.audit:
在 master 节点上运行以下命令：
ps -ef | grep kube-apiserver

验证 --enable-admission-plugins 参数是否设置为包含 PodSecurityPolicy 的值。
extraDetail.remediation:
遵循文档并根据您的环境创建 Pod 安全策略对象。然后，编辑主节点上的 API Server 的 pod 规范文件 /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml 并将 --enable-admission-plugins 参数设置为包含 PodSecurityPolicy 的值：
 --enable-admission-plugins=... ,PodSecurityPolicy,... 
然后重启 API Server。
extraDetail.impact: 必须在允许创建 pod 之前创建和授予策略对象。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，PodSecurityPolicy 未设置。
extraDetail.description_en: Do not disable the secure port.
extraDetail.rationale_en: The secure port is used to serve https with authentication and authorization. If you disable it, no https traffic is served and all traffic is served unencrypted.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command on the Control Plane node: ps -ef | grep kube-apiserver Verify that the --secure-port argument is either not set or is set to an integer value between 1 and 65535.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Edit the API server pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml on the Control Plane node and either remove the --secure-port parameter or set it to a different (non-zero) desired port.
extraDetail.impact_en: You need to set the API Server up with the right TLS certificates.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, port 6443 is used as the secure port.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the admission control plugin NodeRestriction is set (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保准入控制插件节点限制已设置（自动）
remediation_en:
Follow the Kubernetes documentation and configure NodeRestriction plug-in on kubelets.
Then, edit the API server pod specification file $apiserverconf
on the master node and set the --enable-admission-plugins parameter to a
value that includes NodeRestriction.
--enable-admission-plugins=...,NodeRestriction,...
remediation_zh:
遵循Kubernetes文档并在kubelets上配置NodeRestriction插件。然后，在master节点编辑API服务器pod规范文件$apiserverconf
并将--enable-admission-plugins参数设置为包含NodeRestriction的值。
--enable-admission-plugins=...,NodeRestriction,...

extraDetail.description: 限制 kubelet 可以修改的 Node 和 Pod 对象。
extraDetail.rationale: 使用 NodeRestriction 插件可确保 kubelet 仅限于它可以按定义修改的 Node 和 Pod 对象。这样的 kubelet 将只被允许修改自己的 Node API 对象，并且只能修改绑定到其节点的 Pod API 对象。
extraDetail.audit:
在 master 节点上运行以下命令：
ps -ef | grep kube-apiserver

验证 --enable-admission-plugins 参数是否设置为包含 NodeRestriction 的值。
extraDetail.remediation:
按照 Kubernetes 文档，在 kubelets 上配置 NodeRestriction 插件。然后，编辑主节点上的 API Server的 pod 规范文件 /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml，并将 --enable-admission-plugins 参数设置为包含 NodeRestriction 的值：
 --enable-admission-plugins=…,NodeRestriction,…
extraDetail.impact: 无。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，未设置 NodeRestriction。
extraDetail.description_en: Limit the Node and Pod objects that a kubelet could modify.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Using the NodeRestriction plug-in ensures that the kubelet is restricted to the Node and Pod objects that it could modify as defined. Such kubelets will only be allowed to modify their own Node API object, and only modify Pod API objects that are bound to their node.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command on the Control Plane node: ps -ef | grep kube-apiserver Verify that the --enable-admission-plugins argument is set to a value that includes NodeRestriction.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Follow the Kubernetes documentation and configure NodeRestriction plug-in on kubelets. Then, edit the API server pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml on the master node and set the --enable-admission-plugins parameter to a value that includes NodeRestriction. --enable-admission-plugins=...,NodeRestriction,...
extraDetail.impact_en: None
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, NodeRestriction is not set.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the --insecure-bind-address argument is not set (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保未设置--unsecure-bind-address参数（自动）
remediation_en:
Edit the API server pod specification file $apiserverconf
on the master node and remove the --insecure-bind-address parameter.
remediation_zh:
在master节点编辑API服务器pod规范文件$apiserverconf，
并删除--unsecure-bind-address参数。

extraDetail.description: 不要绑定不安全的 API 服务。
extraDetail.rationale: 如果你将 apiserver 绑定到一个不安全的地址，基本上任何可以通过不安全端口连接到它的人，都会对你的 master 节点进行未经身份验证和未加密的访问。 apiserver 不会对不安全的绑定进行任何身份验证检查，并且到不安全 API 端口的流量不会被加密，从而允许攻击者潜在地读取传输中的敏感数据。
extraDetail.audit:
在master节点上运行以下命令：
ps -ef | grep kube-apiserver

检查 --insecure-bind-address 参数是否存在。
extraDetail.remediation: 编辑 master 节点上的 API Server 的 pod 规范文件 /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml 并删除 --insecure-bind-address 参数。
extraDetail.impact: 与 API Server 的连接将需要有效的身份验证凭据。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下不设置不安全的绑定地址。
extraDetail.description_en: Enable auditing on the Kubernetes API Server and set the desired audit log path.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Auditing the Kubernetes API Server provides a security-relevant chronological set of records documenting the sequence of activities that have affected system by individual users, administrators or other components of the system. Even though currently, Kubernetes provides only basic audit capabilities, it should be enabled. You can enable it by setting an appropriate audit log path.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command on the Control Plane node: ps -ef | grep kube-apiserver Verify that the --audit-log-path argument is set as appropriate.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the --request-timeout argument is set as appropriate (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保将--request-timeout参数设置为适当的（自动）
remediation_en:
Edit the API server pod specification file $apiserverconf
and set the below parameter as appropriate and if needed.
For example,
--request-timeout=300s
remediation_zh:
编辑API服务器pod规范文件$apiserverconf,并根据需要设置以下参数。
例如：
--request-timeout=300s

extraDetail.description: 根据需要为 API Server 请求设置全局请求超时。
extraDetail.rationale: 设置全局请求超时允许将API Server的请求超时限制扩展到与用户的连接速度相适应的时间。默认情况下，它被设置为60秒，这在较慢的连接上可能是有问题的，一旦请求的数据量超过了60秒内可以传输的数据量，集群资源就无法访问了。但是，将这个超时限制设置得过大，会耗尽API Server的资源，使其容易受到拒绝服务攻击。因此，建议适当地设置这个限制，只在需要时改变默认的60秒限制。
extraDetail.audit:
master节点上运行以下命令：
ps -ef | grep kube-apiserver

检查 --request-timeout 是否设置或者配置为合适的值。
extraDetail.remediation: 编辑 API Server 的 pod 规范文件 /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml 并根据需要设置以下参数。例如：––request-timeout=300s 。
extraDetail.impact: 无。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，––request-timeout 设置为 60 秒。
extraDetail.description_en: Set global request timeout for API server requests as appropriate.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Setting global request timeout allows extending the API server request timeout limit to a duration appropriate to the user's connection speed. By default, it is set to 60 seconds which might be problematic on slower connections making cluster resources inaccessible once the data volume for requests exceeds what can be transmitted in 60 seconds. But, setting this timeout limit to be too large can exhaust the API server resources making it prone to Denial-of-Service attack. Hence, it is recommended to set this limit as appropriate and change the default limit of 60 seconds only if needed.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command on the Control Plane node: ps -ef | grep kube-apiserver Verify that the --request-timeout argument is either not set or set to an appropriate value.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Edit the API server pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml and set the below parameter as appropriate and if needed. For example, --request-timeout=300s
extraDetail.impact_en: None
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, --request-timeout is set to 60 seconds.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the --service-account-lookup argument is set to true (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保--service-account-lookup参数设置为true（自动）
remediation_en:
Edit the API server pod specification file $apiserverconf
on the master node and set the below parameter.
--service-account-lookup=true
Alternatively, you can delete the --service-account-lookup parameter from this file so
that the default takes effect.
remediation_zh:
编辑API服务器pod规范文件$apiserverconf,并设置以下参数。
--service-account-lookup=true
或者，您可以从此文件中删除--service-account-lookup参数，以便默认值生效。

extraDetail.description: 在验证令牌之前验证Service Account。
extraDetail.rationale: 如果 --service-account-lookup 未启用，apiserver 仅验证身份验证令牌是否有效，而不验证请求中提到的Service Account令牌是否确实存在于 etcd 中。即使在相应的Service Account被删除后，这也允许使用服务帐户令牌。这是检查时间到使用时间安全问题的示例。
extraDetail.audit:
在master节点上运行以下命令：
ps -ef | grep kube-apiserver

验证--service-account-lookup 参数是否存在并且设置为 true。
extraDetail.remediation: 编辑 master 节点上的 API Server 的 pod 规范文件 /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml 并设置以下参数：--service-account-lookup=true。 或者，您可以从该文件中删除 --service-account-lookup 参数，以使默认值生效。`
extraDetail.impact: 无。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，--service-account-lookup 参数设置为 true。
extraDetail.description_en: Validate service account before validating token.
extraDetail.rationale_en: If --service-account-lookup is not enabled, the apiserver only verifies that the authentication token is valid, and does not validate that the service account token mentioned in the request is actually present in etcd. This allows using a service account token even after the corresponding service account is deleted. This is an example of time of check to time of use security issue.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command on the Control Plane node: ps -ef | grep kube-apiserver Verify that if the --service-account-lookup argument exists it is set to true.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Edit the API server pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml on the Control Plane node and set the below parameter. --service-account-lookup=true Alternatively, you can delete the --service-account-lookup parameter from this file so that the default takes effect.
extraDetail.impact_en: None
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, --service-account-lookup argument is set to true.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the --service-account-key-file argument is set as appropriate (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保--service-account-key-file参数设置为适当的（自动）
remediation_en:
Edit the API server pod specification file $apiserverconf
on the master node and set the --service-account-key-file parameter
to the public key file for service accounts:
--service-account-key-file=<filename>
remediation_zh:
编辑API服务器pod规范文件$apiserverconf，并设置--service-account-key-file参数到服务帐户的公钥文件：
--service-account-key-file=<filename>

extraDetail.description: 为 apiserver 上的服务帐户显式设置服务帐户公钥文件。
extraDetail.rationale: 默认情况下，如果没有为 apiserver 指定 --service-account-key-file，它会使用 TLS 服务证书中的私钥来验证服务帐户令牌。为确保可以根据需要轮换服务帐户令牌的密钥，应使用单独的公钥/私钥对来签署服务帐户令牌。因此，应该使用 --service-account-key-file 将公钥指定给 apiserver。
extraDetail.audit:
在master节点上运行以下命令：
ps -ef | grep kube-apiserver

验证 --service-account-key-file 参数是否存在并且设置得当。
extraDetail.remediation: 在 master 节点上编辑 API server pod 规范文件 /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml 并将 --service-account-key-file 参数设置为服务帐户的公钥文件。例如：--service-account -key-file=<文件名>
extraDetail.impact: 相应的私钥必须提供给 controller manager。您需要安全地维护密钥文件并根据组织的密钥轮换策略轮换密钥。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，--service-account-key-file 参数未设置。
extraDetail.description_en: Explicitly set a service account public key file for service accounts on the apiserver.
extraDetail.rationale_en: By default, if no --service-account-key-file is specified to the apiserver, it uses the private key from the TLS serving certificate to verify service account tokens. To ensure that the keys for service account tokens could be rotated as needed, a separate public/private key pair should be used for signing service account tokens. Hence, the public key should be specified to the apiserver with --service-account-key-file.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command on the Control Plane node: ps -ef | grep kube-apiserver Verify that the --service-account-key-file argument exists and is set as appropriate.

extraDetail.audit:

ps -ef | grep kube-apiserver

验证 --tls-cert-file 和 --tls-private-key-file 参数是否存在并且它们被适当地设置。

按照 Kubernetes 文档并在 apiserver 上设置 TLS 连接。然后，在主节点上编辑 API server pod 规范文件 /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml 并设置 TLS 证书和私钥文件参数：

--tls-private-key-file=<path/to/tls-key-file>
extraDetail.impact: 必须为您的 Kubernetes 集群部署配置 TLS 和客户端证书身份验证。

extraDetail.description_en: Setup TLS connection on the Kubelets.
extraDetail.rationale_en: The connections from the apiserver to the kubelet are used for fetching logs for pods, attaching (through kubectl) to running pods, and using the kubelet’s port-forwarding functionality. These connections terminate at the kubelet’s HTTPS endpoint. By default, the apiserver does not verify the kubelet’s serving certificate, which makes the connection subject to man-in-the-middle attacks, and unsafe to run over untrusted and/or public networks. Audit: Run the following command on each node: ps -ef | grep kubelet Verify that the --tls-cert-file and --tls-private-key-file arguments exist and they are set as appropriate. If these arguments are not present, check that there is a Kubelet config specified by --config and that it contains appropriate settings for tlsCertFile and tlsPrivateKeyFile. Remediation: If using a Kubelet config file, edit the file to set tlsCertFile to the location of the certificate file to use to identify this Kubelet, and tlsPrivateKeyFile to the location of the corresponding private key file. If using command line arguments, edit the kubelet service file /etc/kubernetes/kubelet.conf on each worker node and set the below parameters in KUBELET_CERTIFICATE_ARGS variable. --tls-cert-file=<path/to/tls-certificate-file> --tls-private-key-file=<path/to/tls-key-file> Based on your system, restart the kubelet service. For example: systemctl daemon-reload systemctl restart kubelet.service

extraDetail.rationale: API Server 通信包含敏感数据，应在传输过程中保持加密。配置API Server，使其只提供HTTPS流量。如果设置了--client-ca-file参数，出示由 client-ca-file 中的任何一个权威机构签署的客户证书的请求都会被认证为与客户证书的 CommonName 对应的身份。

在master节点上运行以下命令：
ps -ef | grep kube-apiserver

验证 --client-ca-file 参数存在，且被设置为一个恰当的值。
extraDetail.remediation: 按照Kubernetes文档，在apiserver上设置TLS连接。然后，在 master 节点上编辑API Server 的 pod规范文件/etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml，设置客户端证书授权文件：--client-ca-file=<path/to/client-ca-file>。
extraDetail.impact: 必须为你的Kubernetes集群部署配置TLS和客户端证书认证。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，--client-ca-file 参数未设置。
extraDetail.description_en: Enable Kubelet authentication using certificates.
extraDetail.rationale_en: The connections from the apiserver to the kubelet are used for fetching logs for pods, attaching (through kubectl) to running pods, and using the kubelet’s port-forwarding functionality. These connections terminate at the kubelet’s HTTPS endpoint. By default, the apiserver does not verify the kubelet’s serving certificate, which makes the connection subject to man-in-the-middle attacks, and unsafe to run over untrusted and/or public networks. Enabling Kubelet certificate authentication ensures that the apiserver could authenticate the Kubelet before submitting any requests.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command on each node: ps -ef | grep kubelet Verify that the --client-ca-file argument exists and is set to the location of the client certificate authority file. If the --client-ca-file argument is not present, check that there is a Kubelet config file specified by --config, and that the file sets authentication: x509: clientCAFile to the location of the client certificate authority file.
extraDetail.remediation_en: If using a Kubelet config file, edit the file to set authentication: x509: clientCAFile to the location of the client CA file. If using command line arguments, edit the kubelet service file /etc/kubernetes/kubelet.conf on each worker node and set the below parameter in KUBELET_AUTHZ_ARGS variable. --client-ca-file=<path/to/client-ca-file> Based on your system, restart the kubelet service. For example: systemctl daemon-reload systemctl restart kubelet.service
