detail_en: Ensure that the --terminated-pod-gc-threshold argument is set as appropriate (Manual)
detail_zh: 确保将--terminated-pod-gc-threshold参数设置为适当的（手动）
remediation_en:
Edit the Controller Manager pod specification file $controllermanagerconf
on the master node and set the --terminated-pod-gc-threshold to an appropriate threshold,
for example:
--terminated-pod-gc-threshold=10
remediation_zh:
在master节点编辑控制器管理器pod规范文件$controllermanagerconf，并将--terminated-pod-gc-threshold设置为适当的阈值，
例如：
--terminated-pod-gc-threshold=10

extraDetail.description: 酌情在 pod 终止时激活垃圾收集器。
extraDetail.rationale: 垃圾收集对于确保足够的资源可用性和避免性能和可用性下降非常重要。在最坏的情况下，系统可能会崩溃或长时间无法使用。垃圾收集的当前设置是 12,500 个终止的 pod，这可能对您的系统而言太高而无法维持。根据您的系统资源和测试，选择适当的阈值来激活垃圾收集。
extraDetail.audit:
在控制平面节点上运行以下命令：
ps -ef | grep kube-controller-manager

验证 --terminated-pod-gc-threshold 参数设置是否合适。
extraDetail.remediation:
编辑控制平面节点上的 Controller Manager pod 规范文件 /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-controller-manager.yaml 并将 --terminated-pod-gc-thresholdt 设置为适当的阈值，例如：
--terminated-pod-gc-threshold=10
extraDetail.impact: 无。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，--terminated-pod-gc-threshold 设置为 12500。
extraDetail.description_en: Activate garbage collector on pod termination, as appropriate.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Garbage collection is important to ensure sufficient resource availability and avoiding degraded performance and availability. In the worst case, the system might crash or just be unusable for a long period of time. The current setting for garbage collection is 12,500 terminated pods which might be too high for your system to sustain. Based on your system resources and tests, choose an appropriate threshold value to activate garbage collection.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command on the Control Plane node: ps -ef | grep kube-controller-manager Verify that the --terminated-pod-gc-threshold argument is set as appropriate.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Edit the Controller Manager pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-controller-manager.yaml on the Control Plane node and set the --terminated-pod-gc-threshold to an appropriate threshold, for example: --terminated-pod-gc-threshold=10
extraDetail.impact_en: None
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, --terminated-pod-gc-threshold is set to 12500.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the --profiling argument is set to false (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保--profiling参数设置为false（自动）
remediation_en:
Edit the Controller Manager pod specification file $controllermanagerconf
on the master node and set the below parameter.
--profiling=false
remediation_zh:
在master节点编辑控制器管理器pod规范文件$controllermanagerconf并设置以下参数。
--profiling=false

extraDetail.description: 如果不需要，禁用 profiling。
extraDetail.rationale: Profiling 允许识别具体的性能瓶颈。它会生成大量程序数据，这些数据可能被用来发现系统和程序细节。如果您没有遇到任何瓶颈并且不需要分析器进行故障排除，建议将其关闭以减少潜在的攻击面。
extraDetail.audit:
在master节点上运行以下命令：
ps -ef | grep kube-controller-manager

检查 --profiling 参数的值是否为 false。
extraDetail.remediation: 编辑 master 节点上的 API 服务器 pod 规范文件 /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-controller-manager.yaml 并设置以下参数：--profiling=false
extraDetail.impact: profiling信息将不可用。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，启用profiling。
extraDetail.description_en: Disable profiling, if not needed.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Profiling allows for the identification of specific performance bottlenecks. It generates a significant amount of program data that could potentially be exploited to uncover system and program details. If you are not experiencing any bottlenecks and do not need the profiler for troubleshooting purposes, it is recommended to turn it off to reduce the potential attack surface.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command on the Control Plane node: ps -ef | grep kube-scheduler Verify that the --profiling argument is set to false.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Edit the Scheduler pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-scheduler.yaml file on the Control Plane node and set the below parameter. --profiling=false
extraDetail.impact_en: Profiling information would not be available.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, profiling is enabled.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the --use-service-account-credentials argument is set to true (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保--use-service-account-credentials参数设置为true（自动）
remediation_en:
Edit the Controller Manager pod specification file $controllermanagerconf
on the master node to set the below parameter.
--use-service-account-credentials=true
remediation_zh:
在master节点编辑控制器管理器pod规范文件$controllermanagerconf设置以下参数。
--use-service-account-credentials=true

extraDetail.description: 为每个 controller 使用单独的 Service Account 凭据。
extraDetail.rationale: controller manger 在 kube-system 命名空间中为每个控制器创建一个 Service Account，为其生成一个凭证，并使用该 Service Account 凭证构建一个专用 API 客户端，供每个 controller 循环使用。将 --use-service-account-credentials 设置为 true 使用单独的 Service Account 凭据运行controller manger 中的每个控制循环。当与 RBAC 结合使用时，这可确保控制循环以执行其预期任务所需的最低权限运行。
extraDetail.audit:
在 master 节点上运行以下命令：
ps -ef | grep kube-controller-manager

检查 --use-service-account-credentials 参数是否设置为 true。
extraDetail.remediation:
编辑主节点上的 Controller Manager pod 规范文件 /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-controller-manager.yaml 以设置以下参数：
--use-service-account-credentials=true
extraDetail.impact: 无论为集群配置了什么授权者，它都必须向 Service Account 授予足够的权限以执行其预期任务。使用 RBAC 授权方时，这些角色会自动创建并绑定到 kube-system 命名空间中的相应 Service Account，默认角色和角色绑定会在启动时自动协调。如果使用其他授权方法（ABAC、Webhook 等），集群部署者负责为 Service Account 授予适当的权限（所需的权限可以通过检查 controller-roles.yaml 和 controller-role-bindings.yaml RBAC 角色的文件。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，--use-service-account-credentials 设置为 false。
extraDetail.description_en: Use individual service account credentials for each controller.
extraDetail.rationale_en: The controller manager creates a service account per controller in the kube-system namespace, generates a credential for it, and builds a dedicated API client with that service account credential for each controller loop to use. Setting the --use-service-account-credentials to true runs each control loop within the controller manager using a separate service account credential. When used in combination with RBAC, this ensures that the control loops run with the minimum permissions required to perform their intended tasks.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command on the Control Plane node: ps -ef | grep kube-controller-manager Verify that the --use-service-account-credentials argument is set to true.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Edit the Controller Manager pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-controller-manager.yaml on the Control Plane node to set the below parameter. --use-service-account-credentials=true
extraDetail.impact_en: Whatever authorizer is configured for the cluster, it must grant sufficient permissions to the service accounts to perform their intended tasks. When using the RBAC authorizer, those roles are created and bound to the appropriate service accounts in the kube-system namespace automatically with default roles and rolebindings that are auto-reconciled on startup. If using other authorization methods (ABAC, Webhook, etc), the cluster deployer is responsible for granting appropriate permissions to the service accounts (the required permissions can be seen by inspecting the controller-roles.yaml and controller-role-bindings.yaml files for the RBAC roles.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, --use-service-account-credentials is set to false.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the --service-account-private-key-file argument is set as appropriate (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保--service-account-private-key-file参数设置为适当的（自动）
remediation_en:
Edit the Controller Manager pod specification file $controllermanagerconf
on the master node and set the --service-account-private-key-file parameter
to the private key file for service accounts.
--service-account-private-key-file=<filename>
remediation_zh:
在master节点编辑控制器管理器pod规范文件$controllermanagerconf，
并为服务账户的私钥文件设置--service-account-private-key-file参数。
--service-account-private-key-file=<filename>

extraDetail.description: 在controller manager上为service account显式设置私钥文件。
extraDetail.rationale: 为确保可以根据需要轮换服务帐户令牌的密钥，应使用单独的公钥/私钥对来签署service account令牌。应酌情使用 --service-account-private-key-file 将私钥指定给 controller manager。
extraDetail.audit:
在master节点上运行以下命令：
ps -ef | grep kube-controller-manager

验证 --service-account-private-key-file 参数是否已适当设置。
extraDetail.remediation:
编辑主节点上的 Controller Manager pod 规范文件 /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-controller-manager.yaml 并将 --service-account-private-key-file 参数设置为服务帐户的私钥文件：
--service-account-private-key-file=<filename>
extraDetail.impact: 您需要安全地维护密钥文件并根据组织的密钥轮换策略轮换密钥。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，--service-account-private-key-file 未设置。
extraDetail.description_en: Explicitly set a service account private key file for service accounts on the controller manager.
extraDetail.rationale_en: To ensure that keys for service account tokens can be rotated as needed, a separate public/private key pair should be used for signing service account tokens. The private key should be specified to the controller manager with --service-account-private-key-file as appropriate.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command on the Control Plane node: ps -ef | grep kube-controller-manager Verify that the --service-account-private-key-file argument is set as appropriate.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Edit the Controller Manager pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-controller-manager.yaml on the Control Plane node and set the --service-account-private-key-file parameter to the private key file for service accounts. --service-account-private-key-file=<filename>
extraDetail.impact_en: You would need to securely maintain the key file and rotate the keys based on your organization's key rotation policy.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, --service-account-private-key-file it not set.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the --root-ca-file argument is set as appropriate (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保将--root-ca-file参数设置为适当的（自动）
remediation_en:
Edit the Controller Manager pod specification file $controllermanagerconf
on the master node and set the --root-ca-file parameter to the certificate bundle file`.
--root-ca-file=<path/to/file>
remediation_zh:
在master节点编辑控制器管理器pod规范文件$controllermanagerconf，并将--root-ca-file参数设置为证书束文件。
--root-ca-file=<path/to/file>

extraDetail.description: 允许 pod 在建立连接之前验证 API Server 的服务证书。
extraDetail.rationale: 在需要连接 API Server的 pod 中运行的进程必须验证 API Server 的服务证书。如果不这样做，可能会受到中间人攻击。使用 --root-ca-file 参数向控制器管理器提供 API 服务器的服务证书的根证书允许控制器管理器将受信任的捆绑包注入 pod，以便它们可以验证与 API Server的 TLS 连接。
extraDetail.audit:
在master节点上运行下面的命令：
ps -ef | grep kube-controller-manager

检查 --root-ca-file 是否存在，并设置为包含 API Server 服务证书的根证书的证书包文件。
extraDetail.remediation: 编辑 master 节点上的 Controller Manager pod 规范文件 /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-controller-manager.yaml 并将 --root-ca-file 参数设置为证书包文件：--root-ca-file= <路径/到/文件>
extraDetail.impact: 您需要设置和维护根证书颁发机构文件。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，--root-ca-file 未设置。
extraDetail.description_en: Allow pods to verify the API server's serving certificate before establishing connections.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Processes running within pods that need to contact the API server must verify the API server's serving certificate. Failing to do so could be a subject to man-in-the-middle attacks. Providing the root certificate for the API server's serving certificate to the controller manager with the --root-ca-file argument allows the controller manager to inject the trusted bundle into pods so that they can verify TLS connections to the API server.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command on the Control Plane node: ps -ef | grep kube-controller-manager Verify that the --root-ca-file argument exists and is set to a certificate bundle file containing the root certificate for the API server's serving certificate.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Edit the Controller Manager pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-controller-manager.yaml on the Control Plane node and set the --root-ca-file parameter to the certificate bundle file`. --root-ca-file=<path/to/file>
extraDetail.impact_en: You need to setup and maintain root certificate authority file.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, --root-ca-file is not set.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the RotateKubeletServerCertificate argument is set to true (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保RotateKubeletServerCertificate参数设置为true（自动）
remediation_en:
Edit the Controller Manager pod specification file $controllermanagerconf
on the master node and set the --feature-gates parameter to include RotateKubeletServerCertificate=true.
--feature-gates=RotateKubeletServerCertificate=true
remediation_zh:
在master节点编辑控制器管理器pod规范文件$controllermanagerconf，
并将--feature-gates参数设置为包含RotateKubeletServerCertificate=true。
--feature-gates=RotateKubeletServerCertificate=true

extraDetail.description: 在 controller-manager 上启用 kubelet 服务器证书轮换。
extraDetail.rationale:
RotateKubeletServerCertificate 导致 kubelet 在引导其客户端凭据后请求服务证书，并在其现有凭据到期时轮换证书。这种自动定期轮换可确保不会因证书过期而导致停机，从而解决 CIA 安全三合会中的可用性问题。
注意：此建议仅适用于您让 kubelet 从 API Server 获取其证书的情况。如果您的 kubelet 证书来自外部权威机构/工具（例如 Vault），那么您需要自己处理轮换。
extraDetail.audit:
在主节点上运行以下命令：
ps -ef | grep kube-controller-manager

验证 RotateKubeletServerCertificate 参数是否存在并设置为 true。
extraDetail.remediation:
编辑 master 节点上的 Controller Manager pod 规范文件 /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-controller-manager.yaml并设置 --feature-gates 参数以包含 RotateKubeletServerCertificate=true：
--feature-gates=RotateKubeletServerCertificate=true
extraDetail.impact: 无。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，未设置 RotateKubeletServerCertificate。
extraDetail.description_en: Enable kubelet server certificate rotation on controller-manager.
extraDetail.rationale_en: RotateKubeletServerCertificate causes the kubelet to both request a serving certificate after bootstrapping its client credentials and rotate the certificate as its existing credentials expire. This automated periodic rotation ensures that the there are no downtimes due to expired certificates and thus addressing availability in the CIA security triad. Note: This recommendation only applies if you let kubelets get their certificates from the API server. In case your kubelet certificates come from an outside authority/tool (e.g. Vault) then you need to take care of rotation yourself.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command on the Control Plane node: ps -ef | grep kube-controller-manager Verify that RotateKubeletServerCertificate argument exists and is set to true.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Edit the Controller Manager pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-controller-manager.yaml on the Control Plane node and set the --feature-gates parameter to include RotateKubeletServerCertificate=true. --feature-gates=RotateKubeletServerCertificate=true
extraDetail.impact_en: None
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, RotateKubeletServerCertificate is set to "true" this recommendation verifies that it has not been disabled.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the --bind-address argument is set to 127.0.0.1 (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保--bind-address参数设置为127.0.0.1（自动）
remediation_en:
Edit the Controller Manager pod specification file $controllermanagerconf
on the master node and ensure the correct value for the --bind-address parameter
remediation_zh: 在master节点编辑控制器管理器pod规范文件$controllermanagerconf，并确保--bind-address参数的值正确

extraDetail.description: 不要将 Controller Manager 服务绑定到非环回不安全地址。
extraDetail.rationale: 默认情况下在端口 10252/TCP 上运行的 Controller Manager API 服务用于提供 healthy 和 metrics 信息，无需身份验证或加密即可使用。因此，它应该只绑定到 localhost ，以最小化集群的攻击面。
extraDetail.audit:
在master节点上运行下面的命令：
ps -ef | grep kube-controller-manager

验证 --bind-address 参数是否被设置为 127.0.0.1。
extraDetail.remediation: 编辑 master 节点上的 Controller Manager 的 pod 规范文件 /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-controller-manager.yaml 并确保 --bind-address 参数的值正确。
extraDetail.impact: 无。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，--bind-address 参数设置为 0.0.0.0。
extraDetail.description_en: Do not bind the scheduler service to non-loopback insecure addresses.
extraDetail.rationale_en: The Scheduler API service which runs on port 10251/TCP by default is used for health and metrics information and is available without authentication or encryption. As such it should only be bound to a localhost interface, to minimize the cluster's attack surface
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command on the Control Plane node: ps -ef | grep kube-scheduler Verify that the --bind-address argument is set to 127.0.0.1
extraDetail.remediation_en: Edit the Scheduler pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-scheduler.yaml on the Control Plane node and ensure the correct value for the --bind-address parameter
extraDetail.impact_en: None
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, the --bind-address parameter is set to 0.0.0.0

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the kubelet service file permissions are set to 644 or more restrictive (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保kubelet service文件权限设置为644或更严格（自动）
remediation_en:
Run the below command (based on the file location on your system) on the each worker node.
For example,
chmod 644 $kubeletsvc
remediation_zh:
在每个工作节点上运行以下命令（基于系统上的文件位置）。
例如，
chmod 644 $kubeletsvc

extraDetail.description: 确保 kubelet 服务文件具有 644 或更严格的权限。
extraDetail.rationale: kubelet 服务文件控制设置工作节点中 kubelet 服务行为的各种参数。您应该限制其文件权限以保持文件的完整性。该文件应该只能由系统上的管理员写入。
extraDetail.audit:
在每个工作节点上运行以下命令（基于系统上的文件位置）。例如，
stat -c %a /etc/systemd/system/kubelet.service.d/10-kubeadm.conf

验证权限是否为 644 或更严格。
extraDetail.remediation:
在每个工作节点上运行以下命令（基于系统上的文件位置）。
例如，chmod 644 /etc/systemd/system/kubelet.service.d/10-kubeadm.conf
extraDetail.impact: 无。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，kubelet 服务文件的权限为 640。
extraDetail.description_en: Ensure that the kubelet service file has permissions of 644 or more restrictive.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the anonymous-auth argument is set to false (Automated)

remediation_en:
If using a Kubelet config file, edit the file to set authentication: anonymous: enabled to
false.

$kubeletsvc on each worker node and

--anonymous-auth=false
Based on your system, restart the kubelet service. For example:
systemctl daemon-reload

remediation_zh:

如果使用可执行参数，请在每个工作节点上编辑kubelet服务文件
$kubeletsvc 并在KUBELET_SYSTEM_PODS_ARGS变量中设置以下参数。

extraDetail.description: 禁用对 Kubelet 服务器的匿名请求。

extraDetail.audit:
如果使用 Kubelet 配置文件，请检查是否有用于身份验证的条目：anonymous: enabled 设置为 false。
在每个节点上运行以下命令：
ps -ef | grep kubelet

验证 --anonymous-auth 参数是否设置为 false。如果在 Kubelet 配置文件中有相应的条目设置为 false，则可以省略此可执行参数。
extraDetail.remediation:
如果使用 Kubelet 配置文件，请编辑该文件以将 authentication: anonymous: enabled 设置为 false。
如果使用可执行参数，请编辑每个工作节点上的 kubelet 服务文件 /etc/systemd/system/kubelet.service.d/10-kubeadm.conf 并在 KUBELET_SYSTEM_PODS_ARGS 变量中设置以下参数：
--anonymous-auth=false
根据您的系统，重新启动 kubelet 服务。例如：systemctl daemon-reload systemctl restart kubelet.service
extraDetail.impact: 匿名请求将被拒绝。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，启用匿名访问。
extraDetail.description_en: Disable anonymous requests to the Kubelet server.
extraDetail.rationale_en: When enabled, requests that are not rejected by other configured authentication methods are treated as anonymous requests. These requests are then served by the Kubelet server. You should rely on authentication to authorize access and disallow anonymous requests.
extraDetail.audit_en: If using a Kubelet configuration file, check that there is an entry for authentication: anonymous: enabled set to false. Run the following command on each node: ps -ef | grep kubelet Verify that the --anonymous-auth argument is set to false. This executable argument may be omitted, provided there is a corresponding entry set to false in the Kubelet config file.
extraDetail.remediation_en: If using a Kubelet config file, edit the file to set authentication: anonymous: enabled to false. If using executable arguments, edit the kubelet service file /etc/kubernetes/kubelet.conf on each worker node and set the below parameter in KUBELET_SYSTEM_PODS_ARGS variable. --anonymous-auth=false Based on your system, restart the kubelet service. For example: systemctl daemon-reload systemctl restart kubelet.service
extraDetail.impact_en: Anonymous requests will be rejected.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, anonymous access is enabled.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the --authorization-mode argument is not set to AlwaysAllow (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保--authorization-mode参数未设置为AlwaysAllow（自动）
remediation_en:
If using a Kubelet config file, edit the file to set authorization: mode to Webhook. If
using executable arguments, edit the kubelet service file
$kubeletsvc on each worker node and
set the below parameter in KUBELET_AUTHZ_ARGS variable.
--authorization-mode=Webhook
Based on your system, restart the kubelet service. For example:
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl restart kubelet.service
remediation_zh:
如果使用Kubelet配置文件，请编辑该文件以设置 authorization: mode to Webhook.
如果使用可执行参数，请在每个工作节点上编辑kubelet服务文件
$kubeletsvc 并在KUBELET_AUTHZ_ARGS 变量中设置以下参数.
--authorization-mode=Webhook
然后根据您的系统，重新启动kubelet服务。例如：
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl restart kubelet.service

extraDetail.description: 不允许所有请求。启用显式授权。
extraDetail.rationale: 默认情况下，Kubelets允许所有已认证的请求（甚至是匿名请求）不需要API Server的明确授权检查。你应该限制这种行为，只允许明确的授权请求。你应该限制这种行为，只允许明确授权的请求。
extraDetail.audit:
在每个节点上运行下面的命令：
ps -ef | grep kubelet

如果 --authorization-mode 参数存在，请检查它是否设置为 AlwaysAllow。
如果 --authorization-mode 参数不存在，请检查是否通过 --config 参数指定了配置文件，并且该文件是否将 authorization: mode 设置为除 AlwaysAllow 之外的其它值 。也可以通过 Kubelet API 端口（通常为 10250/TCP）上的 /configs 端点查看 Kubelet 的运行配置。使用适当的凭据访问这些将提供 Kubelet 配置的详细信息。
extraDetail.remediation:
如果使用的是kubelet配置文件，修改文件的 authorization: mode 为 Webhook 。
如果使用的可执行文件命令行参数，编辑kubelet的service文件 /etc/systemd/system/kubelet.service.d/10-kubeadm.conf，在 KUBELET_AUTHZ_ARGS 变量中设置如下参数：--authorization-mode=Webhook。
基于你的系统，然后重启kubelet服务。例如：systemctl daemon-reload systemctl restart kubelet.service 。
extraDetail.impact: 未经授权的请求将被拒绝。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下, --authorization-mode 参数的值为 AlwaysAllow.
extraDetail.description_en: Do not allow all requests. Enable explicit authorization.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Kubelets, by default, allow all authenticated requests (even anonymous ones) without needing explicit authorization checks from the apiserver. You should restrict this behavior and only allow explicitly authorized requests.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command on each node: ps -ef | grep kubelet If the --authorization-mode argument is present check that it is not set to AlwaysAllow. If it is not present check that there is a Kubelet config file specified by --config, and that file sets authorization: mode to something other than AlwaysAllow. It is also possible to review the running configuration of a Kubelet via the /configz endpoint on the Kubelet API port (typically 10250/TCP). Accessing these with appropriate credentials will provide details of the Kubelet's configuration.
extraDetail.remediation_en: If using a Kubelet config file, edit the file to set authorization: mode to Webhook. If using executable arguments, edit the kubelet service file /etc/kubernetes/kubelet.conf on each worker node and set the below parameter in KUBELET_AUTHZ_ARGS variable. --authorization-mode=Webhook Based on your system, restart the kubelet service. For example: systemctl daemon-reload systemctl restart kubelet.service
extraDetail.impact_en: Unauthorized requests will be denied.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, --authorization-mode argument is set to AlwaysAllow.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the --client-ca-file argument is set as appropriate (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保--client-ca-file参数设置为适当的（自动）
remediation_en:
If using a Kubelet config file, edit the file to set authentication: x509: clientCAFile to
the location of the client CA file.
If using command line arguments, edit the kubelet service file
$kubeletsvc on each worker node and
set the below parameter in KUBELET_AUTHZ_ARGS variable.
--client-ca-file=<path/to/client-ca-file>
Based on your system, restart the kubelet service. For example:
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl restart kubelet.service
remediation_zh:
如果使用Kubelet配置文件，请编辑该文件以设置 authentication: x509: clientCAFile 到客户端CA文件中。
如果使用命令行参数，请在每个工作节点上编辑kubelet服务文件$kubeletsvc
在KUBELET_AUTHZ_ARGS变量中设置以下参数。
--client-ca-file=<path/to/client-ca-file>
然后根据您的系统，重新启动kubelet服务。例如：
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl restart kubelet.service

extraDetail.description: 使用证书启用 Kubelet 身份验证。
extraDetail.rationale: 从API Server到kubelet的连接用于获取pod的日志，（通过kubectl）附加到正在运行的pod，并使用kubelet的端口转发功能。这些连接在kubelet的HTTPS端点终止。默认情况下，API Server不会验证kubelet的服务证书，这使得连接受到中间人攻击，并且在不信任的和/或公共网络上运行不安全。启用Kubelet证书验证可以确保API Server可以在提交任何请求之前对Kubelet进行验证。
extraDetail.audit:
在每个节点上运行以下命令：
ps -ef | grep kubelet

验证 --client-ca-file 参数是否存在并设置为客户端证书颁发机构文件的位置。
如果 --client-ca-file 参数不存在，请检查是否存在由 --config 指定的 Kubelet 配置文件，并且该文件将 authentication: x509: clientCAFile 设置为客户端证书授权文件的位置。
extraDetail.remediation:
如果使用Kubelet配置文件，编辑文件设置 authentication: x509: clientCAFile 客户端CA文件的位置。
如果使用的是命令行参数，编辑每个节点的 Kubelet 服务文件 /etc/systemd/system/kubelet.service.d/10-kubeadm.conf ，在  KUBELET_AUTHZ_ARGS 变量中设置如下参数：--client-ca-file=<path/to/client-ca-file> 。
基于你的系统，重启Kubelet。例如：systemctl daemon-reload systemctl restart kubelet.service
extraDetail.impact: 你需要在API Server以及kubelets上配置TLS。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，--client-ca-file 参数未设置。
extraDetail.description_en: Enable Kubelet authentication using certificates.
extraDetail.rationale_en: The connections from the apiserver to the kubelet are used for fetching logs for pods, attaching (through kubectl) to running pods, and using the kubelet’s port-forwarding functionality. These connections terminate at the kubelet’s HTTPS endpoint. By default, the apiserver does not verify the kubelet’s serving certificate, which makes the connection subject to man-in-the-middle attacks, and unsafe to run over untrusted and/or public networks. Enabling Kubelet certificate authentication ensures that the apiserver could authenticate the Kubelet before submitting any requests.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command on each node: ps -ef | grep kubelet Verify that the --client-ca-file argument exists and is set to the location of the client certificate authority file. If the --client-ca-file argument is not present, check that there is a Kubelet config file specified by --config, and that the file sets authentication: x509: clientCAFile to the location of the client certificate authority file.
extraDetail.remediation_en: If using a Kubelet config file, edit the file to set authentication: x509: clientCAFile to the location of the client CA file. If using command line arguments, edit the kubelet service file /etc/kubernetes/kubelet.conf on each worker node and set the below parameter in KUBELET_AUTHZ_ARGS variable. --client-ca-file=<path/to/client-ca-file> Based on your system, restart the kubelet service. For example: systemctl daemon-reload systemctl restart kubelet.service
extraDetail.impact_en: You require TLS to be configured on apiserver as well as kubelets.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, --client-ca-file argument is not set.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the --read-only-port argument is set to 0 (Manual)
detail_zh: 确保--read-only-port 参数被设置为0 (手动)
remediation_en:
If using a Kubelet config file, edit the file to set readOnlyPort to 0.
If using command line arguments, edit the kubelet service file
$kubeletsvc on each worker node and
set the below parameter in KUBELET_SYSTEM_PODS_ARGS variable.
--read-only-port=0
Based on your system, restart the kubelet service. For example:
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl restart kubelet.service
remediation_zh:
如果使用Kubelet配置文件，请编辑该文件以设置 readOnlyPort to 0.
如果使用命令行参数，请在每个工作节点上编辑 kubelet 服务文件 $kubeletsvc
在KUBELET_SYSTEM_PODS_ARGS变量中设置以下参数。
--read-only-port=0
然后根据您的系统，重新启动kubelet服务。例如：
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl restart kubelet.service

extraDetail.description: 禁用只读端口。
extraDetail.rationale: 除了主Kubelet API之外，Kubelet进程还提供了一个只读API。对这个只读API提供了未经认证的访问，这可能会检索到关于集群的潜在敏感信息。
extraDetail.audit:
每个节点上运行以下命令：
ps -ef | grep kubelet

验证 --read-only-port 参数是否存在，
如果存在是否设置为 0。
如果不存在，检查是否通过 --config  指定配置文件，且文件中的 readOnlyPort 是否设置为 0。
extraDetail.remediation:
如果使用的是配置文件，编辑文件设置 readOnlyPort: 0。
如果使用的是命令行参数，编辑每个节点上的 /etc/systemd/system/kubelet.service.d/10-kubeadm.conf 文件，设置以下 --read-only-port=0
参数到KUBELET_SYSTEM_PODS_ARGS 变量中。
基于你的系统，重启 kubelet 服务。例如：systemctl daemon-reload systemctl restart kubelet.service
extraDetail.impact: 删除只读端口将要求使用它的任何服务都需要重新配置以使用主 Kubelet API。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，--read-only-port 设置为 10255/TCP。但是，如果配置文件由 --config 指定，则 readOnlyPort 的默认值为 0。
extraDetail.description_en: Disable the read-only port.
extraDetail.rationale_en: The Kubelet process provides a read-only API in addition to the main Kubelet API. Unauthenticated access is provided to this read-only API which could possibly retrieve potentially sensitive information about the cluster.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command on each node: ps -ef | grep kubelet Verify that the --read-only-port argument exists and is set to 0. If the --read-only-port argument is not present, check that there is a Kubelet config file specified by --config. Check that if there is a readOnlyPort entry in the file, it is set to 0.
extraDetail.remediation_en: If using a Kubelet config file, edit the file to set readOnlyPort to 0. If using command line arguments, edit the kubelet service file /etc/kubernetes/kubelet.conf on each worker node and set the below parameter in KUBELET_SYSTEM_PODS_ARGS variable. --read-only-port=0 Based on your system, restart the kubelet service. For example: systemctl daemon-reload systemctl restart kubelet.service
extraDetail.impact_en: Removal of the read-only port will require that any service which made use of it will need to be re-configured to use the main Kubelet API.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, --read-only-port is set to 10255/TCP. However, if a config file is specified by --config the default value for readOnlyPort is 0.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the --streaming-connection-idle-timeout argument is not set to 0 (Manual)
detail_zh: 确保--streaming-connection-idle-timeout 参数不被设置为0 (手动)
remediation_en:
If using a Kubelet config file, edit the file to set streamingConnectionIdleTimeout to a
value other than 0.
If using command line arguments, edit the kubelet service file
$kubeletsvc on each worker node and
set the below parameter in KUBELET_SYSTEM_PODS_ARGS variable.
--streaming-connection-idle-timeout=5m
Based on your system, restart the kubelet service. For example:
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl restart kubelet.service
remediation_zh:
如果使用Kubelet配置文件，请编辑该文件以将streamingConnectionIdleTimeout设置为非0。
如果使用命令行参数，请在每个工作节点上编辑 kubelet 服务文件 $kubeletsvc
在KUBELET_SYSTEM_PODS_ARGS变量中设置以下参数。
--streaming-connection-idle-timeout=5m
然后根据您的系统，重新启动kubelet服务。例如：
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl restart kubelet.service

extraDetail.description: 不要禁用流式连接的超时。
extraDetail.rationale:
设置空闲超时可确保您免受拒绝服务攻击、非活动连接和用完临时端口。
注意：默认情况下，--streaming-connection-idle-timeout 设置为 4 小时，这对于您的环境来说可能太高了。将其设置为适当的还可以确保此类流连接在服务合法用例后超时。
extraDetail.audit:
在每个节点上运行以下命令：
ps -ef | grep kubelet

验证 --streaming-connection-idle-timeout参数是否未设置为 0。
如果该参数不存在，并且存在由 --config 指定的 Kubelet 配置文件，请检查它是否未将 streamingConnectionIdleTimeout 设置为 0。
extraDetail.remediation:
如果使用 Kubelet 配置文件，请编辑该文件以将 streamingConnectionIdleTimeout 设置为 0 以外的值。
如果使用命令行参数，请编辑 kubelet 服务文件 /etc/systemd/system/kubelet.service.d/10-kubeadm.conf每个工作节点并在 KUBELET_SYSTEM_PODS_ARGS 变量中设置以下参数：
--streaming-connection-idle-timeout=5m
根据您的系统，重新启动 kubelet 服务。例如：systemctl daemon-reload systemctl restart kubelet.service
extraDetail.impact: 长期连接可能会中断。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，--streaming-connection-idle-timeout 设置为四个小时。
extraDetail.description_en: Do not disable timeouts on streaming connections.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Setting idle timeouts ensures that you are protected against Denial-of-Service attacks, inactive connections and running out of ephemeral ports. Note: By default, --streaming-connection-idle-timeout is set to 4 hours which might be too high for your environment. Setting this as appropriate would additionally ensure that such streaming connections are timed out after serving legitimate use cases.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command on each node: ps -ef | grep kubelet Verify that the --streaming-connection-idle-timeout argument is not set to 0. If the argument is not present, and there is a Kubelet config file specified by --config, check that it does not set streamingConnectionIdleTimeout to 0.
extraDetail.remediation_en: If using a Kubelet config file, edit the file to set streamingConnectionIdleTimeout to a value other than 0. If using command line arguments, edit the kubelet service file /etc/kubernetes/kubelet.conf on each worker node and set the below parameter in KUBELET_SYSTEM_PODS_ARGS variable. --streaming-connection-idle-timeout=5m Based on your system, restart the kubelet service. For example: systemctl daemon-reload systemctl restart kubelet.service
extraDetail.impact_en: Long-lived connections could be interrupted.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, --streaming-connection-idle-timeout is set to 4 hours.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the --protect-kernel-defaults argument is set to true (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保--protect-kernel-defaults参数设置为true（自动）
remediation_en:
If using a Kubelet config file, edit the file to set protectKernelDefaults: true.
If using command line arguments, edit the kubelet service file
$kubeletsvc on each worker node and

remediation_zh:
如果使用Kubelet配置文件，请编辑该文件以设置protectKernelDefaults: true.
如果使用命令行参数，请在每个工作节点上编辑 kubelet 服务文件 $kubeletsvc
在KUBELET_SYSTEM_PODS_ARGS变量中设置以下参数。
--protect-kernel-defaults=true
然后根据您的系统，重新启动kubelet服务。例如：
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl restart kubelet.service

extraDetail.description: 保护调整过的内核参数不覆盖 kubelet 默认内核参数值。
extraDetail.rationale: 内核参数通常是由系统管理员在将系统投入生产前进行调整和加固的。这些参数可以保护内核和系统。你的依赖于这些参数的kubelet内核默认值应该被适当地设置，以匹配所需的安全系统状态。忽视这一点有可能导致运行的pods具有不受欢迎的内核行为。
extraDetail.audit:
在每个节点运行：
ps -ef | grep kubelet

验证--protect-kernel-defaults 参数是否存在，
如果存在是否设置为true。
如果不存在，检查是否通过 --config  指定配置文件，且文件中的 protectKernelDefaults 是否设置为true。
extraDetail.remediation:
如果使用的是配置文件，编辑文件设置 protectKernelDefaults: true。
如果使用的是命令行参数，编辑每个节点上的 /etc/systemd/system/kubelet.service.d/10-kubeadm.conf 文件，设置以下--protect-kernel-defaults=true
参数到KUBELET_SYSTEM_PODS_ARGS 变量中。
基于你的系统，重启 kubelet 服务。例如：systemctl daemon-reload systemctl restart kubelet.service
extraDetail.impact: 您必须重新调整内核参数以匹配 kubelet 参数。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，--protect-kernel-defaults 未设置。
extraDetail.description_en: Protect tuned kernel parameters from overriding kubelet default kernel parameter values.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Kernel parameters are usually tuned and hardened by the system administrators before putting the systems into production. These parameters protect the kernel and the system. Your kubelet kernel defaults that rely on such parameters should be appropriately set to match the desired secured system state. Ignoring this could potentially lead to running pods with undesired kernel behavior.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command on each node: ps -ef | grep kubelet Verify that the --protect-kernel-defaults argument is set to true. If the --protect-kernel-defaults argument is not present, check that there is a Kubelet config file specified by --config, and that the file sets protectKernelDefaults to true.
extraDetail.remediation_en: If using a Kubelet config file, edit the file to set protectKernelDefaults: true. If using command line arguments, edit the kubelet service file /etc/kubernetes/kubelet.conf on each worker node and set the below parameter in KUBELET_SYSTEM_PODS_ARGS variable. --protect-kernel-defaults=true Based on your system, restart the kubelet service. For example: systemctl daemon-reload systemctl restart kubelet.service
extraDetail.impact_en: You would have to re-tune kernel parameters to match kubelet parameters.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, --protect-kernel-defaults is not set.

systemctl restart kubelet.service

extraDetail.description: 允许 Kubelet 管理 iptables。
extraDetail.rationale: Kubelet 可以根据您为 pod 选择网络选项的方式自动管理对 iptables 的所需更改。建议让 kubelets 管理对 iptables 的更改。这可确保 iptables 配置与 pods 网络配置保持同步。使用动态 pod 网络配置更改手动配置 iptables 可能会阻碍 pod/容器与外界的通信。您的 iptables 规则可能过于严格或过于开放。
extraDetail.audit:
在所有节点上运行以下命令：
ps -ef | grep kubelet

检查 --make-iptables-util-chains 参数是否存在，且它的值是否为 true。
如果 --make-iptables-util-chains 不存在，检查是否通过 --config 指定配置文件，检查文件中是否设置 makeIPTablesUtilChains 为 false。
extraDetail.remediation:
如果使用kubelet配置文件，编辑文件设置 makeIPTablesUtilChains: true 。
如果命令行参数，编辑每个工作节点上 kubelet 服务文件 /etc/systemd/system/kubelet.service.d/10-kubeadm.conf，从 KUBELET_SYSTEM_PODS_ARGS 变量中移除 --make-iptables-util-chains 。基于你的系统，重启kubelet服务。例如：systemctl daemon-reload systemctl restart kubelet.service。
extraDetail.impact: Kubelet 将管理系统上的 iptables 并保持同步。如果您使用任何其他 iptables 管理解决方案，则可能存在一些冲突。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下， --make-iptables-util-chains 参数设置为 true。
extraDetail.description_en: Allow Kubelet to manage iptables.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Kubelets can automatically manage the required changes to iptables based on how you choose your networking options for the pods. It is recommended to let kubelets manage the changes to iptables. This ensures that the iptables configuration remains in sync with pods networking configuration. Manually configuring iptables with dynamic pod network configuration changes might hamper the communication between pods/containers and to the outside world. You might have iptables rules too restrictive or too open.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command on each node: ps -ef | grep kubelet Verify that if the --make-iptables-util-chains argument exists then it is set to true. If the --make-iptables-util-chains argument does not exist, and there is a Kubelet config file specified by --config, verify that the file does not set makeIPTablesUtilChains to false.
extraDetail.remediation_en: If using a Kubelet config file, edit the file to set makeIPTablesUtilChains: true. If using command line arguments, edit the kubelet service file /etc/kubernetes/kubelet.conf on each worker node and remove the --make-iptables-util-chains argument from the KUBELET_SYSTEM_PODS_ARGS variable. Based on your system, restart the kubelet service. For example: systemctl daemon-reload systemctl restart kubelet.service
extraDetail.impact_en: Kubelet would manage the iptables on the system and keep it in sync. If you are using any other iptables management solution, then there might be some conflicts.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, --make-iptables-util-chains argument is set to true.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the --hostname-override argument is not set (Manual)
detail_zh: 确保未设置--hostname-override参数（手动）
remediation_en:
Edit the kubelet service file $kubeletsvc
on each worker node and remove the --hostname-override argument from the
KUBELET_SYSTEM_PODS_ARGS variable.
Based on your system, restart the kubelet service. For example:
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl restart kubelet.service
remediation_zh:
编辑kubelet服务文件$kubeletsvc
并从在每个工作节点的KUBELET_SYSTEM_PODS_ARGS变量中移除--hostname-override参数。
然后根据您的系统，重新启动kubelet服务。例如：
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl restart kubelet.service

extraDetail.description: 不要覆盖节点主机名。
extraDetail.rationale: 覆盖主机名可能会破坏 kubelet 和 apiserver 之间的 TLS 设置。此外，由于主机名被覆盖，将日志与特定节点关联并处理它们以进行安全分析变得越来越困难。因此，您应该使用可解析的 FQDN 设置 kubelet 节点，并避免使用 IP 覆盖主机名。
extraDetail.audit:
在每个节点上运行以下命令：
ps -ef | grep kubelet

验证 --hostname-override 参数是否存在。注意此设置不能通过 Kubelet 配置文件进行配置。
extraDetail.remediation:
编辑每个工作节点上的 kubelet 服务文件 /etc/systemd/system/kubelet.service.d/10-kubeadm.conf 并从 KUBELET_SYSTEM_PODS_ARGS 变量中删除 --hostname-override 参数。根据您的系统，重新启动 kubelet 服务.例如：
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl restart kubelet.service
extraDetail.impact: 一些云提供商可能需要此标志以确保主机名与云提供商发布的名称匹配。在这些环境中，此建议不应适用。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，--hostname-override 参数未设置。
extraDetail.description_en: Do not override node hostnames.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Overriding hostnames could potentially break TLS setup between the kubelet and the apiserver. Additionally, with overridden hostnames, it becomes increasingly difficult to associate logs with a particular node and process them for security analytics. Hence, you should setup your kubelet nodes with resolvable FQDNs and avoid overriding the hostnames with IPs.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command on each node: ps -ef | grep kubelet Verify that --hostname-override argument does not exist. Note This setting is not configurable via the Kubelet config file.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Edit the kubelet service file /etc/systemd/system/kubelet.service.d/10-kubeadm.conf on each worker node and remove the --hostname-override argument from the KUBELET_SYSTEM_PODS_ARGS variable. Based on your system, restart the kubelet service. For example: systemctl daemon-reload systemctl restart kubelet.service
extraDetail.impact_en: Some cloud providers may require this flag to ensure that hostname matches names issued by the cloud provider. In these environments, this recommendation should not apply.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, --hostname-override argument is not set.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the --event-qps argument is set to 0 or a level which ensures appropriate event capture (Manual)
detail_zh: 确保--event-qps参数设置为0或确保适当事件捕获的级别（手动）
remediation_en:
If using a Kubelet config file, edit the file to set eventRecordQPS: to an appropriate level.
If using command line arguments, edit the kubelet service file
$kubeletsvc on each worker node and
set the below parameter in KUBELET_SYSTEM_PODS_ARGS variable.
Based on your system, restart the kubelet service. For example:
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl restart kubelet.service
remediation_zh:
如果使用Kubelet配置文件，请编辑文件并设置eventRecordQPS: 为一个合适的级别.
如果使用命令行参数，请在每个工作节点上编辑kubelet服务文件
$kubeletsvc，并在KUBELET_SYSTEM_PODS_ARGS变量中设置以下参数。
然后根据您的系统，重新启动kubelet服务。例如：
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl restart kubelet.service

extraDetail.description: 应捕获安全相关信息。 kubelet 上的 --event-qps 标志可用于限制收集事件的速率。将此值设置得太低可能会导致相关事件不被记录，但是无限制设置 0 可能会导致 kubelet 上的拒绝服务。
extraDetail.rationale: 重要的是要捕获所有事件而不是限制事件创建。事件是安全信息和分析的重要来源，可确保使用事件数据持续监控您的环境。
extraDetail.audit:
在每个节点上运行以下命令：
ps -ef | grep kubelet

查看为 --event-qps 参数设置的值，并确定这是否已设置为适合集群的级别。值 0 可用于确保捕获所有事件。如果 --event-qps 参数不存在，请检查是否存在由 --config 指定的 Kubelet 配置文件并查看此位置中的值。
extraDetail.remediation:
如果使用 Kubelet 配置文件，请编辑该文件以将 eventRecordQPS: 设置为适当的级别。如果使用命令行参数，请编辑每个 kubelet 服务文件 /etc/systemd/system/kubelet.service.d/10-kubeadm.conf工作节点并在 KUBELET_SYSTEM_PODS_ARGS 变量中设置以下参数。根据您的系统，重新启动 kubelet 服务。例如：
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl restart kubelet.service
extraDetail.impact: 将此参数设置为 0 可能会由于创建过多事件而导致拒绝服务情况。应该扩展集群的事件处理和存储系统以处理预期的事件负载。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，--event-qps 参数设置为 5。
extraDetail.description_en: Security relevant information should be captured. The eventRecordQPS on the Kubelet configuration can be used to limit the rate at which events are gathered and sets the maximum event creations per second. Setting this too low could result in relevant events not being logged, however the unlimited setting of 0 could result in a denial of service on the kubelet.
extraDetail.rationale_en: It is important to capture all events and not restrict event creation. Events are an important source of security information and analytics that ensure that your environment is consistently monitored using the event data.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command on each node: sudo grep "eventRecordQPS" /etc/systemd/system/kubelet.service.d/10-kubeadm.conf```  Review the value set for the argument and determine whether this has been set to an appropriate level for the cluster.  If the argument does not exist, check that there is a Kubelet config file specified by `--config` and review the value in this location.
extraDetail.remediation_en: If using a Kubelet config file, edit the file to set eventRecordQPS: to an appropriate level. If using command line arguments, edit the kubelet service file /etc/systemd/system/kubelet.service.d/10-kubeadm.conf on each worker node and set the below parameter in KUBELET_SYSTEM_PODS_ARGS variable. Based on your system, restart the kubelet service. For example: systemctl daemon-reload systemctl restart kubelet.service
extraDetail.impact_en: Setting this parameter to 0 could result in a denial of service condition due to excessive events being created. The cluster's event processing and storage systems should be scaled to handle expected event loads.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, eventRecordQPS argument is set to 5.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the --tls-cert-file and --tls-private-key-file arguments are set as appropriate (Manual)
detail_zh: 确保--tls-cert-file 和--tls-private-key-file 参数被设置为适当值 (手动)
remediation_en:
If using a Kubelet config file, edit the file to set tlsCertFile to the location
of the certificate file to use to identify this Kubelet, and tlsPrivateKeyFile
to the location of the corresponding private key file.
If using command line arguments, edit the kubelet service file
$kubeletsvc on each worker node and
set the below parameters in KUBELET_CERTIFICATE_ARGS variable.
--tls-cert-file=<path/to/tls-certificate-file>
--tls-private-key-file=<path/to/tls-key-file>
Based on your system, restart the kubelet service. For example:
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl restart kubelet.service
remediation_zh:
如果使用Kubelet配置文件，编辑文件以将tlsCertFile设置为用于标识此Kubelet的证书文件的位置
以及tlsPrivateKeyFile到相应私钥文件的位置
如果使用命令行参数，请在每个工作节点上编辑kubelet服务文件
$kubeletsvc在KUBELET_CERTIFICATE_ARGS变量中设置以下参数。
--tls-cert-file=<path/to/tls-certificate-file>
--tls-private-key-file=<path/to/tls-key-file>
然后根据您的系统，重新启动kubelet服务。例如：
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl restart kubelet.service

extraDetail.description: 在 Kubelets 上设置 TLS 连接。
extraDetail.rationale: Kubelet 通信包含在传输过程中应保持加密的敏感参数。将 Kubelet 配置为仅提供 HTTPS 流量。
extraDetail.audit:
在每个节点上运行以下命令：
ps -ef | grep kubelet

验证 --tls-cert-file 和 --tls-private-key-file 参数是否存在并且它们被适当地设置。
如果这些参数不存在，请检查是否存在由 --config 指定的 Kubelet 配置，以及它是否包含 tlsCertFile 和 tlsPrivateKeyFile 的适当设置。
extraDetail.remediation:
如果使用 Kubelet 配置文件，请编辑该文件以将 tlsCertFile 设置为用于标识此 Kubelet 的证书文件的位置，并将 tlsPrivateKeyFile 设置为相应私钥文件的位置。
如果使用命令行参数，请在每个工作节点上编辑 kubelet 服务文件 /etc/systemd/system/kubelet.service.d/10-kubeadm.conf 并在 KUBELET_CERTIFICATE_ARGS 变量中设置以下参数：
--tls-cert-file=<path/to/tls-certificate-file>
--tls-private-key-file=<path/to/tls-key-file>
根据您的系统，重新启动 kubelet 服务。例如：systemctl daemon-reload systemctl restart kubelet.service
extraDetail.impact: 必须为您的 Kubernetes 集群部署配置 TLS 和客户端证书身份验证。
extraDetail.defaultValue:
默认情况下，--tls-cert-file和 --tls-private-key-file 参数未设置。
如果未提供 --tls-cert-file 和 --tls-private-key-file，则会为公共地址生成自签名证书和密钥，并保存到传递给 --cert-dir 的目录中。
extraDetail.description_en: Setup TLS connection on the Kubelets.
extraDetail.rationale_en: The connections from the apiserver to the kubelet are used for fetching logs for pods, attaching (through kubectl) to running pods, and using the kubelet’s port-forwarding functionality. These connections terminate at the kubelet’s HTTPS endpoint. By default, the apiserver does not verify the kubelet’s serving certificate, which makes the connection subject to man-in-the-middle attacks, and unsafe to run over untrusted and/or public networks. Audit: Run the following command on each node: ps -ef | grep kubelet Verify that the --tls-cert-file and --tls-private-key-file arguments exist and they are set as appropriate. If these arguments are not present, check that there is a Kubelet config specified by --config and that it contains appropriate settings for tlsCertFile and tlsPrivateKeyFile. Remediation: If using a Kubelet config file, edit the file to set tlsCertFile to the location of the certificate file to use to identify this Kubelet, and tlsPrivateKeyFile to the location of the corresponding private key file. If using command line arguments, edit the kubelet service file /etc/kubernetes/kubelet.conf on each worker node and set the below parameters in KUBELET_CERTIFICATE_ARGS variable. --tls-cert-file=<path/to/tls-certificate-file> --tls-private-key-file=<path/to/tls-key-file> Based on your system, restart the kubelet service. For example: systemctl daemon-reload systemctl restart kubelet.service
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command on each node: ps -ef | grep kubelet Verify that the --tls-cert-file and --tls-private-key-file arguments exist and they are set as appropriate. If these arguments are not present, check that there is a Kubelet config specified by --config and that it contains appropriate settings for tlsCertFile and tlsPrivateKeyFile.
extraDetail.remediation_en: If using a Kubelet config file, edit the file to set tlsCertFile to the location of the certificate file to use to identify this Kubelet, and tlsPrivateKeyFile to the location of the corresponding private key file. If using command line arguments, edit the kubelet service file /etc/kubernetes/kubelet.conf on each worker node and set the below parameters in KUBELET_CERTIFICATE_ARGS variable. --tls-cert-file=<path/to/tls-certificate-file> --tls-private-key-file=<path/to/tls-key-file> Based on your system, restart the kubelet service. For example: systemctl daemon-reload systemctl restart kubelet.service

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the --rotate-certificates argument is not set to false (Manual)
detail_zh: 确保--rotate-certificates参数未被设置为false (手动)
remediation_en:
If using a Kubelet config file, edit the file to add the line rotateCertificates: true or
remove it altogether to use the default value.
If using command line arguments, edit the kubelet service file
$kubeletsvc on each worker node and
remove --rotate-certificates=false argument from the KUBELET_CERTIFICATE_ARGS
variable.
Based on your system, restart the kubelet service. For example:
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl restart kubelet.service
remediation_zh:
如果使用Kubelet配置文件，请编辑该文件以添加rotateCertificates:true行，或将其一起删除以使用默认值.
如果使用命令行参数，请编辑每个工作节点上的kubelet服务文件$kubeletsvc，
并从kubelet_CERTIFICATE_ARGS变量中删除--rotate-certificates=false参数。
Based on your system, restart the kubelet service. For example:
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl restart kubelet.service

extraDetail.description: 启用 kubelet 客户端证书轮换。
extraDetail.rationale:
--rotate-certificates 设置会导致 kubelet 在其现有凭证过期时通过创建新的 CSR 来轮换其客户端证书。这种自动定期轮换可确保不会因证书过期而导致停机，从而解决 CIA 安全三合会中的可用性问题。
注意：此建议仅适用于您让 kubelet 从 API Server获取其证书的情况。如果您的 kubelet 证书来自外部权威机构/工具（例如 Vault），那么您需要自己处理轮换。
注意：此功能还需要启用 RotateKubeletClientCertificate 特性门（这是自 Kubernetes v1.7 以来的默认设置）。
extraDetail.audit:
在每个节点上运行以下命令：
ps -ef | grep kubelet

检查 --rotate-certificates 参数是否存在，或者是否设置为true。
如果 --rotate-certificates 不存在，检查是否通过 --config 指定了配置文件，且文件中是否包含了 rotateCertificates: false 。
extraDetail.remediation:
如果使用 Kubelet 配置文件，请编辑文件以添加行 rotateCertificates: true 或完全删除它以使用默认值。
如果使用命令行参数，请编辑每个工作节点上的 kubelet 服务文件 /etc/systemd/system/kubelet.service.d/10-kubeadm.conf 并从 KUBELET_CERTIFICATE_ARGS 变量中删除 --rotate-certificates=false 参数。
根据您的系统，重新启动 kubelet 服务。例如：systemctl daemon-reload systemctl restart kubelet.service 。
extraDetail.impact: 无。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，启用 kubelet 客户端证书轮换。
extraDetail.description_en: Enable kubelet client certificate rotation.
extraDetail.rationale_en: The --rotate-certificates setting causes the kubelet to rotate its client certificates by creating new CSRs as its existing credentials expire. This automated periodic rotation ensures that the there is no downtime due to expired certificates and thus addressing availability in the CIA security triad. Note: This recommendation only applies if you let kubelets get their certificates from the API server. In case your kubelet certificates come from an outside authority/tool (e.g. Vault) then you need to take care of rotation yourself. Note: This feature also require the RotateKubeletClientCertificate feature gate to be enabled (which is the default since Kubernetes v1.7)
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command on each node: ps -ef | grep kubelet Verify that the --rotate-certificates argument is not present, or is set to true. If the --rotate-certificates argument is not present, verify that if there is a Kubelet config file specified by --config, that file does not contain rotateCertificates: false.
extraDetail.remediation_en: If using a Kubelet config file, edit the file to add the line rotateCertificates: true or remove it altogether to use the default value. If using command line arguments, edit the kubelet service file /etc/kubernetes/kubelet.conf on each worker node and remove --rotate-certificates=false argument from the KUBELET_CERTIFICATE_ARGS variable. Based on your system, restart the kubelet service. For example: systemctl daemon-reload systemctl restart kubelet.service
extraDetail.impact_en: None
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, kubelet client certificate rotation is enabled.

creator: default
detail_en: Verify that the RotateKubeletServerCertificate argument is set to true (Manual)
detail_zh: 确保RotateKubeletServerCertificate参数被设置为true(手动)
remediation_en:
Edit the kubelet service file $kubeletsvc
on each worker node and set the below parameter in KUBELET_CERTIFICATE_ARGS variable.
--feature-gates=RotateKubeletServerCertificate=true
Based on your system, restart the kubelet service. For example:
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl restart kubelet.service
remediation_zh:
在每个工作节点上编辑kubelet服务文件$kubeletsvc，并在kubelet_CERTIFICATE_ARGS变量中设置以下参数。
--feature-gates=RotateKubeletServerCertificate=true
然后根据您的系统，重新启动kubelet服务。例如：
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl restart kubelet.service

extraDetail.description: 启用 kubelet 服务器证书轮换。
extraDetail.rationale:
RotateKubeletServerCertificate 导致 kubelet 在引导其客户端凭据后请求服务证书，并在其现有凭据到期时轮换证书。这种自动定期轮换可确保不会因证书过期而导致停机，从而解决 CIA 安全三合会中的可用性问题。
注意：此建议仅适用于您让 kubelet 从 API Server 获取其证书的情况。如果您的 kubelet 证书来自外部权威机构/工具（例如 Vault），那么您需要自己处理轮换。
extraDetail.audit:
在每个节点上运行以下命令：
ps -ef | grep kubelet

验证 RotateKubeletServerCertificate 参数是否存在并设置为 true。
extraDetail.remediation:
在 master 节点上编辑 /var/lib/kubelet/kubeadm-flags.env 并设置参数 KUBELET_CERTIFICATE_ARGS --feature-gates=RotateKubeletServerCertificate=true 或作为替代方案，建议作为最后的手段，编辑 kubelet 服务文件 /etc/ systemd/system/kubelet.service.d/10-kubeadm.conf 在每个工作节点上，并在 KUBELET_CERTIFICATE_ARGS 变量中设置以下参数：
--feature-gates=RotateKubeletServerCertificate=true
根据您的系统，重新启动 kubelet 服务。例如：
systemctl daemon-reload systemctl restart kubelet.service
extraDetail.impact: 无。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，kubelet 服务器证书轮换是禁用的。
extraDetail.description_en: Enable kubelet server certificate rotation.
extraDetail.rationale_en: RotateKubeletServerCertificate causes the kubelet to both request a serving certificate after bootstrapping its client credentials and rotate the certificate as its existing credentials expire. This automated periodic rotation ensures that the there are no downtimes due to expired certificates and thus addressing availability in the CIA security triad. Note: This recommendation only applies if you let kubelets get their certificates from the API server. In case your kubelet certificates come from an outside authority/tool (e.g. Vault) then you need to take care of rotation yourself.
extraDetail.audit_en: Ignore this check if serverTLSBootstrap is true in the kubelet config file or if the --rotate-server-certificates parameter is set on kubelet Run the following command on each node: ps -ef | grep kubelet Verify that RotateKubeletServerCertificate argument exists and is set to true.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Edit the kubelet service file /etc/kubernetes/kubelet.conf on each worker node and set the below parameter in KUBELET_CERTIFICATE_ARGS variable. --feature-gates=RotateKubeletServerCertificate=true Based on your system, restart the kubelet service. For example: systemctl daemon-reload systemctl restart kubelet.service
extraDetail.impact_en: None
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, kubelet server certificate rotation is enabled.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the Kubelet only makes use of Strong Cryptographic Ciphers (Manual)
detail_zh: 确保Kubelet只使用强密码（手动）
remediation_en:
If using a Kubelet config file, edit the file to set TLSCipherSuites: to
TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256,TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256,TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_CHACHA20_POLY1305,TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384,TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_CHACHA20_POLY1305,TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384,TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384,TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256
or to a subset of these values.
If using executable arguments, edit the kubelet service file
$kubeletsvc on each worker node and
set the --tls-cipher-suites parameter as follows, or to a subset of these values.
--tls-cipher-suites=TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256,TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256,TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_CHACHA20_POLY1305,TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384,TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_CHACHA20_POLY1305,TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384,TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384,TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256
Based on your system, restart the kubelet service. For example:

如果使用Kubelet配置文件，请编辑该文件设置TLSCipherSuites: 为
TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256,TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256,TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_CHACHA20_POLY1305,TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384,TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_CHACHA20_POLY1305,TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384,TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384,TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256
或这些的∂子集.
如果使用可执行参数，请编辑每个工作节点上的kubelet服务文件$kubeletsvc，并按如下所示设置--tls-cipher-suites参数，或将其设置为这些值的子集。
--tls-cipher-suites=TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256,TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256,TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_CHACHA20_POLY1305,TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384,TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_CHACHA20_POLY1305,TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384,TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384,TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256
然后根据您的系统，重新启动kubelet服务。例如：

extraDetail.description: 确保将 Kubelet 配置为仅使用强加密密码。
extraDetail.rationale: TLS 密码有许多已知的漏洞和弱点，这会降低它们提供的保护。默认情况下，Kubernetes 支持许多 TLS 密码套件，包括一些存在安全问题的密码套件，从而削弱了所提供的保护。
extraDetail.audit:
目前被认为是安全的密码密码集如下：
1. TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256
2. TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256
3. TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_CHACHA20_POLY1305
4. TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384

8. TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256

如果存在 --tls-cipher-suites 参数，请确保它仅包含此集中包含的值。如果不存在，请检查是否存在由 --config 指定的 Kubelet 配置文件，并且该文件将 TLSCipherSuites: 设置为仅包含此集合中的值。

根据您的系统，重新启动 kubelet 服务。例如：
