extraDetail.impact: 不支持现代加密密码的 Kubelet 客户端将无法连接到 Kubelet API。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，Kubernetes API 服务器支持广泛的 TLS 密码
extraDetail.description_en: Ensure that the Kubelet is configured to only use strong cryptographic ciphers.
extraDetail.rationale_en: TLS ciphers have had a number of known vulnerabilities and weaknesses, which can reduce the protection provided by them. By default Kubernetes supports a number of TLS ciphersuites including some that have security concerns, weakening the protection provided.
extraDetail.audit_en: The set of cryptographic ciphers currently considered secure is the following: •  TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256 •  TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256 •  TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_CHACHA20_POLY1305 •  TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384 •  TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_CHACHA20_POLY1305 •  TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384 •  TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384 •  TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256 Run the following command on each node: ps -ef | grep kubelet If the --tls-cipher-suites argument is present, ensure it only contains values included in this set. If it is not present check that there is a Kubelet config file specified by --config, and that file sets TLSCipherSuites: to only include values from this set.
extraDetail.remediation_en: If using a Kubelet config file, edit the file to set TLSCipherSuites: to TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256,TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256,TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_CHACHA20_POLY1305,TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384,TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_CHACHA20_POLY1305,TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384,TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384,TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256 or to a subset of these values. If using executable arguments, edit the kubelet service file /etc/kubernetes/kubelet.conf on each worker node and set the --tls-cipher-suites parameter as follows, or to a subset of these values.  --tls-cipher-suites=TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256,TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256,TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_CHACHA20_POLY1305,TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384,TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_CHACHA20_POLY1305,TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384,TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384,TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256 Based on your system, restart the kubelet service. For example: systemctl daemon-reload systemctl restart kubelet.service
extraDetail.impact_en: Kubelet clients that cannot support modern cryptographic ciphers will not be able to make connections to the Kubelet API.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default the Kubernetes API server supports a wide range of TLS ciphers Additional Information: The list chosen above should be fine for modern clients. It's essentially the list from the Mozilla "Modern cipher" option with the ciphersuites supporting CBC mode removed, as CBC has traditionally had a lot of issues

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the cluster-admin role is only used where required (Manual)
detail_zh: 确保群集管理角色仅在需要时使用（手动）
remediation_en:
Identify all clusterrolebindings to the cluster-admin role. Check if they are used and
if they need this role or if they could use a role with fewer privileges.
Where possible, first bind users to a lower privileged role and then remove the
clusterrolebinding to the cluster-admin role :
kubectl delete clusterrolebinding [name]
remediation_zh:
识别群集管理角色的所有clusterrolebindings。
检查是否使用了它们，是否需要此角色，或者是否可以使用权限较少的角色。
在可能的情况下，首先将用户绑定到较低权限的角色，然后将clusterrolebinding删除到集群管理角色：
kubectl delete clusterrolebinding[name]

extraDetail.description: RBAC 角色 cluster-admin 提供了对环境的广泛权力，只应在需要的地方和需要时使用。
extraDetail.rationale: Kubernetes 提供了一组使用 RBAC 的默认角色。其中一些角色（例如 cluster-admin）提供了广泛的权限，仅应在绝对必要的情况下应用。诸如 cluster-admin 之类的角色允许超级用户访问对任何资源执行任何操作。在 ClusterRoleBinding 中使用时，它可以完全控制集群和所有命名空间中的每个资源。在 RoleBinding 中使用时，它可以完全控制角色绑定命名空间中的每个资源，包括命名空间本身。
extraDetail.audit:
通过查看有权访问 cluster-admin 角色的每个角色绑定的 clusterrolebinding 输出，获取有权访问 cluster-admin 角色的委托人列表。
kubectl get clusterrolebindings -o=custom-columns=NAME:.metadata.name,ROLE:.roleRef.name,SUBJECT:.subjects[*].name

查看列出的每个主体，并确保其需要 cluster-admin 权限。
extraDetail.remediation:
识别与 cluster-admin 角色的所有 clusterrolebindings。检查他们是否被使用以及他们是否需要这个角色，或者他们是否可以使用具有较少权限的角色。如果可能，首先将用户绑定到较低权限的角色，然后将 clusterrolebinding 删除到 cluster-admin 角色：
kubectl delete clusterrolebinding [name]
extraDetail.impact: 在从环境中删除任何 clusterrolebinding 之前应小心，以确保它们不是集群操作所必需的。具体来说，不应该对带有system:前缀的clusterrolebinding进行修改，因为它们是系统组件运行所必需的。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，一个名为 cluster-admin 的集群角色绑定以 system:masters 组作为其主体。
extraDetail.description_en: The RBAC role cluster-admin provides wide-ranging powers over the environment and should be used only where and when needed.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Kubernetes provides a set of default roles where RBAC is used. Some of these roles such as cluster-admin provide wide-ranging privileges which should only be applied where absolutely necessary. Roles such as cluster-admin allow super-user access to perform any action on any resource. When used in a ClusterRoleBinding, it gives full control over every resource in the cluster and in all namespaces. When used in a RoleBinding, it gives full control over every resource in the rolebinding's namespace, including the namespace itself.
extraDetail.audit_en: Obtain a list of the principals who have access to the cluster-admin role by reviewing the clusterrolebinding output for each role binding that has access to the cluster-admin role. kubectl get clusterrolebindings -o=custom-columns=NAME:.metadata.name,ROLE:.roleRef.name,SUBJECT:.subjects[*].name Review each principal listed and ensure that cluster-admin privilege is required for it.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Identify all clusterrolebindings to the cluster-admin role. Check if they are used and if they need this role or if they could use a role with fewer privileges. Where possible, first bind users to a lower privileged role and then remove the clusterrolebinding to the cluster-admin role : kubectl delete clusterrolebinding [name]
extraDetail.impact_en: Care should be taken before removing any clusterrolebindings from the environment to ensure they were not required for operation of the cluster. Specifically, modifications should not be made to clusterrolebindings with the system: prefix as they are required for the operation of system components.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default a single clusterrolebinding called cluster-admin is provided with the system:masters group as its principal.

creator: default
detail_en: Minimize access to secrets (Manual)
detail_zh: 最小化对敏感信息的访问（手动）
remediation_en: Where possible, remove get, list and watch access to secret objects in the cluster.
remediation_zh: 在可能的情况下，删除对群集中敏感对象的get、list和watch访问。

extraDetail.description: Kubernetes API 存储 Secret，这些 Secret 可能是 Kubernetes API 的service account token 或集群中工作负载使用的凭据。对这些 Secret 的访问应仅限于尽可能小的用户组，以降低特权升级的风险。
extraDetail.rationale: 对存储在 Kubernetes 集群中的 Secret 的不当访问可以让攻击者获得对 Kubernetes 集群或其凭据作为Secret 存储的外部资源的额外访问权限。
extraDetail.audit: 查看对 Kubernetes API 中的Secret 对象具有 get、list 或 watch 访问权限的用户。
extraDetail.remediation: 在可能的情况下，删除对集群中 Secret 对象的 get、list 和 watch 访问。
extraDetail.impact: 应注意不要删除对其操作需要的系统组件的 Secret 访问。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，在 kubeadm 集群中，存在对 Secret 有get权限的主体。
extraDetail.description_en: The Kubernetes API stores secrets, which may be service account tokens for the Kubernetes API or credentials used by workloads in the cluster. Access to these secrets should be restricted to the smallest possible group of users to reduce the risk of privilege escalation.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Inappropriate access to secrets stored within the Kubernetes cluster can allow for an attacker to gain additional access to the Kubernetes cluster or external resources whose credentials are stored as secrets.
extraDetail.audit_en: Review the users who have get, list or watch access to secrets objects in the Kubernetes API.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Where possible, remove get, list and watch access to secret objects in the cluster.
extraDetail.impact_en: Care should be taken not to remove access to secrets to system components which require this for their operation
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default in a kubeadm cluster the following list of principals have get privileges on secret objects CLUSTERROLEBINDING                                    SUBJECT                             TYPE            SA-NAMESPACE cluster-admin                                         system:masters                      Group            system:controller:clusterrole-aggregation-controller  clusterrole-aggregation-controller  ServiceAccount  kube-system system:controller:expand-controller                   expand-controller                   ServiceAccount  kube-system system:controller:generic-garbage-collector           generic-garbage-collector           ServiceAccount  kube-system system:controller:namespace-controller                namespace-controller                ServiceAccount  kube-system system:controller:persistent-volume-binder            persistent-volume-binder            ServiceAccount  kube-system system:kube-controller-manager                             User

creator: default
detail_en: Minimize wildcard use in Roles and ClusterRoles (Manual)
detail_zh: 最小化角色和集群角色中的通配符使用（手动）
remediation_en:
Where possible replace any use of wildcards in clusterroles and roles with specific
objects or actions.
remediation_zh: 在可能的情况下，用特定的对象或操作替换clusterroles和role中通配符的任何用法。

extraDetail.description: Kubernetes Roles 和 ClusterRoles 基于对象集和可以对这些对象执行的操作提供对资源的访问。可以将其中任何一个设置为匹配所有项目的通配符“*”。从安全角度来看，通配符的使用并不是最佳选择，因为它可能允许在将新资源添加到 Kubernetes API 时授予无意的访问权限作为 CRD 或在产品的更高版本中。
extraDetail.rationale: 最小权限原则建议仅向用户提供其角色所需的访问权限，仅此而已。使用通配符权限授予可能会为 Kubernetes API 提供过多的权限。
extraDetail.audit:
检索跨集群中每个命名空间定义的角色并查看通配符
kubectl get roles --all-namespaces -o yaml

检索集群中定义的集群角色并查看通配符
kubectl get clusterroles -o yaml
extraDetail.remediation: 在可能的情况下，将集群角色和角色中通配符的任何使用替换为特定对象或操作。
extraDetail.description_en: Kubernetes Roles and ClusterRoles provide access to resources based on sets of objects and actions that can be taken on those objects. It is possible to set either of these to be the wildcard "*" which matches all items. Use of wildcards is not optimal from a security perspective as it may allow for inadvertent access to be granted when new resources are added to the Kubernetes API either as CRDs or in later versions of the product.
extraDetail.rationale_en: The principle of least privilege recommends that users are provided only the access required for their role and nothing more. The use of wildcard rights grants is likely to provide excessive rights to the Kubernetes API. Audit: Retrieve the roles defined across each namespaces in the cluster and review for wildcards kubectl get roles --all-namespaces -o yaml Retrieve the cluster roles defined in the cluster and review for wildcards kubectl get clusterroles -o yaml Remediation: Where possible replace any use of wildcards in clusterroles and roles with specific objects or actions.
extraDetail.audit_en: Retrieve the roles defined across each namespaces in the cluster and review for wildcards kubectl get roles --all-namespaces -o yaml Retrieve the cluster roles defined in the cluster and review for wildcards kubectl get clusterroles -o yaml
extraDetail.remediation_en: Where possible replace any use of wildcards in clusterroles and roles with specific objects or actions.

creator: default
detail_en: Minimize access to create pods (Manual)
detail_zh: 最小化创建pods的访问权限（手动）
remediation_en: Where possible, remove create access to pod objects in the cluster.
remediation_zh: 在可能的情况下，删除对集群中pod对象的create访问。

extraDetail.description:
在命名空间中创建 pod 的能力可以为特权升级提供许多机会，例如为这些 pod 分配特权服务帐户或挂载具有敏感数据访问权限的 hostPath（除非实施 Pod 安全策略来限制这种访问）。
因此，创建新 pod 的访问权限应仅限于尽可能少的用户组。
extraDetail.rationale: 在集群中创建 Pod 的能力为特权升级开辟了可能性，应尽可能加以限制。
extraDetail.audit: 查看对 Kubernetes API 中的 pod 对象具有 create 权限的用户。
extraDetail.remediation: 在可能的情况下，删除对集群中 pod 对象 create 权限。
extraDetail.impact: 应注意不要删除对 pod 对系统组件的访问，这些组件需要这样做才能运行。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，kubeadm 集群中存在对pod对象具有create权限的对象。
extraDetail.description_en: The ability to create pods in a namespace can provide a number of opportunities for privilege escalation, such as assigning privileged service accounts to these pods or mounting hostPaths with access to sensitive data (unless Pod Security Policies are implemented to restrict this access) As such, access to create new pods should be restricted to the smallest possible group of users.
extraDetail.rationale_en: The ability to create pods in a cluster opens up possibilities for privilege escalation and should be restricted, where possible.
extraDetail.audit_en: Review the users who have create access to pod objects in the Kubernetes API.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Where possible, remove create access to pod objects in the cluster.
extraDetail.impact_en: Care should be taken not to remove access to pods to system components which require this for their operation
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default in a kubeadm cluster the following list of principals have create privileges on pod objects CLUSTERROLEBINDING                                    SUBJECT                             TYPE            SA-NAMESPACE cluster-admin                                         system:masters                      Group            system:controller:clusterrole-aggregation-controller  clusterrole-aggregation-controller  ServiceAccount  kube-system system:controller:daemon-set-controller               daemon-set-controller               ServiceAccount  kube-system system:controller:job-controller                      job-controller                      ServiceAccount  kube-system system:controller:persistent-volume-binder            persistent-volume-binder            ServiceAccount  kube-system system:controller:replicaset-controller               replicaset-controller               ServiceAccount  kube-system system:controller:replication-controller              replication-controller              ServiceAccount  kube-system system:controller:statefulset-controller              statefulset-controller              ServiceAccount  kube-system

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that default service accounts are not actively used. (Manual)
detail_zh: 确保默认服务帐户未被频繁使用(（手动）
remediation_en:
Create explicit service accounts wherever a Kubernetes workload requires specific access
to the Kubernetes API server.
Modify the configuration of each default service account to include this value
automountServiceAccountToken: false
remediation_zh:
在Kubernetes工作负载需要特定访问kubernetesapi服务器的地方创建显式服务帐户。
修改每个默认服务帐户的配置以包含此值
automountServiceAccountToken: false

extraDetail.description: 不应使用默认ServiceAccount来确保可以更轻松地审核和审查授予应用程序的权限。
extraDetail.rationale: Kubernetes 提供了一个默认ServiceAccount，供集群工作负载使用，其中没有为 pod 分配特定ServiceAccount。如果需要从 pod 访问 Kubernetes API，则应为该 pod 创建一个特定的ServiceAccount，并将权限授予该ServiceAccount。应配置默认ServiceAccount，使其不提供ServiceAccount令牌并且没有任何明确的权限分配。
extraDetail.audit: 对于集群中的每个命名空间，检查分配给默认ServiceAccount的权限，并确保除了默认值之外，它没有绑定任何角色或集群角色。此外，确保每个默认ServiceAccount都有 automountServiceAccountToken: false 设置。
extraDetail.remediation: 只要 Kubernetes 工作负载需要对 Kubernetes API 服务器的特定访问权限，就可以创建显式ServiceAccount。修改每个默认ServiceAccount的配置以包含此值 automountServiceAccountToken: false。
extraDetail.impact: 所有需要访问 Kubernetes API 的工作负载都需要创建一个明确的ServiceAccount。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，默认ServiceAccount允许将其ServiceAccount令牌安装在其命名空间的 pod 中。
extraDetail.description_en: The default service account should not be used to ensure that rights granted to applications can be more easily audited and reviewed.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Kubernetes provides a default service account which is used by cluster workloads where no specific service account is assigned to the pod. Where access to the Kubernetes API from a pod is required, a specific service account should be created for that pod, and rights granted to that service account. The default service account should be configured such that it does not provide a service account token and does not have any explicit rights assignments.
extraDetail.audit_en: For each namespace in the cluster, review the rights assigned to the default service account and ensure that it has no roles or cluster roles bound to it apart from the defaults. Additionally ensure that the automountServiceAccountToken: false setting is in place for each default service account.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Create explicit service accounts wherever a Kubernetes workload requires specific access to the Kubernetes API server. Modify the configuration of each default service account to include this value automountServiceAccountToken: false
extraDetail.impact_en: All workloads which require access to the Kubernetes API will require an explicit service account to be created.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default the default service account allows for its service account token to be mounted in pods in its namespace.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that Service Account Tokens are only mounted where necessary (Manual)
detail_zh: 确保服务帐户令牌仅在必要时装载（手动）
remediation_en:
Modify the definition of pods and service accounts which do not need to mount service
account tokens to disable it.
remediation_zh: 修改不需要挂载服务帐户令牌的pod和服务帐户的定义以禁用它。

extraDetail.description: Service accounts token 不应安装在 pod 中，除非在 pod 中运行的工作负载明确需要与 API 服务器通信。
extraDetail.rationale: 在 pod 中安装service account token 可以为特权升级攻击提供途径，攻击者可以在集群中破坏单个 pod。避免安装这些令牌可以消除这种攻击途径。
extraDetail.audit:
查看集群中的 pod 和 service account 对象，并确保设置了以下选项，除非资源明确需要此访问权限。
automountServiceAccountToken: false
extraDetail.remediation: 修改不需要挂载service account token 的pod和 service account 的定义以禁用它。
extraDetail.impact: 没有service account token 挂载的 Pod 将无法与 API 服务器通信，除非资源可供未经身份验证的主体使用。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，所有 pod 都会在其中安装一个 service account token 。
extraDetail.description_en: Service accounts tokens should not be mounted in pods except where the workload running in the pod explicitly needs to communicate with the API server
extraDetail.rationale_en: Mounting service account tokens inside pods can provide an avenue for privilege escalation attacks where an attacker is able to compromise a single pod in the cluster. Avoiding mounting these tokens removes this attack avenue.
extraDetail.audit_en: Review pod and service account objects in the cluster and ensure that the option below is set, unless the resource explicitly requires this access. automountServiceAccountToken: false
extraDetail.remediation_en: Modify the definition of pods and service accounts which do not need to mount service account tokens to disable it.
extraDetail.impact_en: Pods mounted without service account tokens will not be able to communicate with the API server, except where the resource is available to unauthenticated principals.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, all pods get a service account token mounted in them.

creator: default
detail_en: Minimize the admission of privileged containers (Manual)
detail_zh: 尽量减少特权容器的进入（手动）
remediation_en:
Create a PSP as described in the Kubernetes documentation, ensuring that
the .spec.privileged field is omitted or set to false.
remediation_zh: 按照Kubernetes文档中的描述创建PSP，确保spec.privileged 字段被省略或设置为false。

extraDetail.description: 通常不允许容器在 securityContext.privileged 标志设置为 true 的情况下运行。
extraDetail.rationale:
特权容器可以访问所有 Linux 内核功能和设备。以完全权限运行的容器几乎可以做主机可以做的所有事情。此标志的存在是为了允许特殊用例，例如操作网络堆栈和访问设备。
应该至少定义一个不允许特权容器的准入控制策略。
如果您需要运行特权容器，这应该定义在单独的策略，您应该仔细检查以确保只有有限的 service account 和用户被授予使用该策略的权限。
extraDetail.audit: 列出集群中每个命名空间使用的策略，确保每个策略都不允许特权容器进入。
extraDetail.remediation: 向集群中具有用户工作负载的每个命名空间添加策略，以限制特权容器的准入。
extraDetail.impact: 不允许使用 spec.containers[].securityContext.privileged: true、spec.initContainers[].securityContext.privileged: true 和 spec.ephemeralContainers[].securityContext.privileged: true 定义的 Pod。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，对特权容器的创建没有限制。
extraDetail.description_en: Do not generally permit containers to be run with the securityContext.privileged flag set to true.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Privileged containers have access to all Linux Kernel capabilities and devices. A container running with full privileges can do almost everything that the host can do. This flag exists to allow special use-cases, like manipulating the network stack and accessing devices. There should be at least one admission control policy defined which does not permit privileged containers. If you need to run privileged containers, this should be defined in a separate policy and you should carefully check to ensure that only limited service accounts and users are given permission to use that policy.
extraDetail.audit_en: List the policies in use for each namespace in the cluster, ensure that each policy disallows the admission of privileged containers.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Add policies to each namespace in the cluster which has user workloads to restrict the admission of privileged containers.
extraDetail.impact_en: Pods defined with spec.containers[].securityContext.privileged: true, spec.initContainers[].securityContext.privileged: true and spec.ephemeralContainers[].securityContext.privileged: true will not be permitted.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, there are no restrictions on the creation of privileged containers.

creator: default
detail_en: Minimize the admission of containers wishing to share the host process ID namespace (Manual)
detail_zh: 尽量减少对希望共享主机进程ID命名空间的容器的允许（手动）
remediation_en:
Create a PSP as described in the Kubernetes documentation, ensuring that the
.spec.hostPID field is omitted or set to false.
remediation_zh: 按照Kubernetes文档中的描述创建一个PSP，确保spec.hostPID 字段被省略或设置为false。

extraDetail.description: 通常不允许容器在 hostPID 标志设置为 true 的情况下运行。
extraDetail.rationale: 在主机的 PID 命名空间中运行的容器可以检查在容器外运行的进程。如果容器还可以访问 ptrace 功能，则可以使用它来提升容器外部的权限。应该至少定义一个 PodSecurityPolicy (PSP)，它不允许容器共享主机 PID 命名空间。如果您需要运行需要 hostPID 的容器，这应该在单独的 PSP 中定义，并且您应该仔细检查 RBAC 控件以确保只有有限的ServiceAccount 和用户被授予访问该 PSP 的权限。
extraDetail.audit: 使用以下命令获取 PSP 集：kubectl get psp。对于每个 PSP，检查是否启用了特权：kubectl get psp <name> -o=jsonpath='{.spec.hostPID}'。验证至少有一个不返回 true 的 PSP。
extraDetail.remediation: 按照 Kubernetes 文档中的说明创建 PSP，确保 .spec.hostPID 字段被省略或设置为 false。
extraDetail.impact: 不允许使用 spec.hostPID: true 定义的 Pod，除非它们在特定 PSP 下运行。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，PodSecurityPolicies 未定义。
extraDetail.description_en: Do not generally permit containers to be run with the hostPID flag set to true.
extraDetail.rationale_en: A container running in the host's PID namespace can inspect processes running outside the container. If the container also has access to ptrace capabilities this can be used to escalate privileges outside of the container. There should be at least one admission control policy defined which does not permit containers to share the host PID namespace. If you need to run containers which require hostPID, this should be defined in a separate policy and you should carefully check to ensure that only limited service accounts and users are given permission to use that policy.
extraDetail.audit_en: List the policies in use for each namespace in the cluster, ensure that each policy disallows the admission of hostPID containers
extraDetail.remediation_en: Add policies to each namespace in the cluster which has user workloads to restrict the admission of hostPID containers.
extraDetail.impact_en: Pods defined with spec.hostPID: true will not be permitted unless they are run under a specific policy.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, there are no restrictions on the creation of hostPID containers.

creator: default
detail_en: Minimize the admission of containers wishing to share the host IPC namespace (Manual)
detail_zh: 尽量减少对希望共享主机IPC命名空间的容器的允许（手动）
remediation_en:
Create a PSP as described in the Kubernetes documentation, ensuring that the
.spec.hostIPC field is omitted or set to false.
remediation_zh: 按照Kubernetes文档中的描述创建一个PSP，确保.spec.hostIPC 字段被省略或设置为false。

extraDetail.description: 通常不允许容器在 hostIPC 标志设置为 true 的情况下运行。
extraDetail.rationale: 在主机的 IPC 命名空间中运行的容器可以使用 IPC 与容器外的进程进行交互。应该至少定义一个 PodSecurityPolicy (PSP)，它不允许容器共享主机 IPC 命名空间。如果您对需要 hostIPC 的容器有要求，这应该在单独的 PSP 中定义，并且您应该仔细检查 RBAC 控制以确保只有有限的 ServiceAccount 和用户被授予访问该 PSP 的权限。
extraDetail.audit: 使用以下命令获取 PSP 集：kubectl get psp。对于每个 PSP，检查是否启用了特权：kubectl get psp <name> -o=jsonpath='{.spec.hostIPC}'。验证至少有一个不返回 true 的 PSP。
extraDetail.remediation: 按照 Kubernetes 文档中的说明创建 PSP，确保 .spec.hostIPC 字段被省略或设置为 false。
extraDetail.impact: 不允许使用 spec.hostIPC: true 定义的 Pod，除非它们在特定 PSP 下运行。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，PodSecurityPolicies 未定义。
extraDetail.description_en: Do not generally permit containers to be run with the hostIPC flag set to true.
extraDetail.rationale_en: A container running in the host's IPC namespace can use IPC to interact with processes outside the container. There should be at least one admission control policy defined which does not permit containers to share the host IPC namespace. If you need to run containers which require hostIPC, this should be defined in a separate policy and you should carefully check to ensure that only limited service accounts and users are given permission to use that policy.
extraDetail.audit_en: List the policies in use for each namespace in the cluster, ensure that each policy disallows the admission of hostIPC containers
extraDetail.remediation_en: Add policies to each namespace in the cluster which has user workloads to restrict the admission of hostIPC containers.
extraDetail.impact_en: Pods defined with spec.hostIPC: true will not be permitted unless they are run under a specific policy.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, there are no restrictions on the creation of hostIPC containers.

creator: default
detail_en: Minimize the admission of containers wishing to share the host network namespace (Manual)
detail_zh: 尽量减少对希望共享主机网络命名空间的容器的接纳（手动）
remediation_en:
Create a PSP as described in the Kubernetes documentation, ensuring that the
.spec.hostNetwork field is omitted or set to false.
remediation_zh: 按照Kubernetes文档中的描述创建一个PSP，确保.spec.hostNetwork 字段被省略或设置为false。

extraDetail.description: Minimize the admission of containers wishing to share the host network namespace
extraDetail.rationale: 在主机的网络命名空间中运行的容器可以访问本地环回设备，并且可以访问进出其他 pod 的网络流量。应该至少定义一个 PodSecurityPolicy (PSP) 不允许容器共享主机网络命名空间。如果您需要运行需要 hostNetwork 的容器，这应该在单独的 PSP 中定义，并且您应该仔细检查 RBAC 控制以确保只有有限的ServiceAccount 和用户被授予访问该 PSP 的权限。
extraDetail.audit: 使用以下命令获取 PSP 集：kubectl get psp。kubectl get psp <name> -o=jsonpath='{.spec.hostNetwork}'。验证至少有一个不返回 true 的 PSP。
extraDetail.remediation: 按照 Kubernetes 文档中的说明创建 PSP，确保 .spec.hostNetwork 字段被省略或设置为 false。
extraDetail.impact: 不允许使用 spec.hostNetwork: true 定义的 Pod，除非它们在特定 PSP 下运行。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，PodSecurityPolicies 未定义。
extraDetail.description_en: Do not generally permit containers to be run with the hostNetwork flag set to true.
extraDetail.rationale_en: A container running in the host's network namespace could access the local loopback device, and could access network traffic to and from other pods. There should be at least one admission control policy defined which does not permit containers to share the host network namespace. If you need to run containers which require access to the host's network namesapces, this should be defined in a separate policy and you should carefully check to ensure that only limited service accounts and users are given permission to use that policy.
extraDetail.audit_en: List the policies in use for each namespace in the cluster, ensure that each policy disallows the admission of hostNetwork containers
extraDetail.remediation_en: Add policies to each namespace in the cluster which has user workloads to restrict the admission of hostNetwork containers.
extraDetail.impact_en: Pods defined with spec.hostNetwork: true will not be permitted unless they are run under a specific policy.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, there are no restrictions on the creation of hostNetwork containers.

creator: default
detail_en: Minimize the admission of containers with allowPrivilegeEscalation (Manual)
detail_zh: 使用allowPrivilegeEscalation（手动）最大限度地减少容器的进入
remediation_en:
Create a PSP as described in the Kubernetes documentation, ensuring that the
.spec.allowPrivilegeEscalation field is omitted or set to false.
remediation_zh: 按照Kubernetes文档中的描述创建一个PSP，确保.spec.allowPrivilegeEscalation 字段被省略或设置为false。

extraDetail.description: 通常不允许容器在 allowPrivilegeEscalation 标志设置为 true 的情况下运行。
extraDetail.rationale: 将 allowPrivilegeEscalation 标志设置为 true 运行的容器可能具有比其父进程获得更多特权的进程。应该至少定义一个 PodSecurityPolicy (PSP)，它不允许容器允许提权。该选项存在（并且默认为 true）以允许 setuid 二进制文件运行。如果您需要运行使用 setuid 二进制文件或需要权限提升的容器，则应在单独的 PSP 中定义，并且您应仔细检查 RBAC 控件以确保仅授予有限的 ServiceAccount 和用户访问该 PSP 的权限。
extraDetail.audit: 使用以下命令获取 PSP 集：kubectl get psp。对于每个 PSP，检查是否启用了特权：kubectl get psp <name> -o=jsonpath='{.spec.allowPrivilegeEscalation}'。验证至少有一个不返回 true 的 PSP。
extraDetail.remediation: 按照 Kubernetes 文档中的说明创建 PSP，确保 .spec.allowPrivilegeEscalation 字段被省略或设置为 false。
extraDetail.impact: 除非在特定 PSP 下运行，否则不允许使用 spec.allowPrivilegeEscalation: true 定义的 Pod。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，PodSecurityPolicies 未定义。
extraDetail.description_en: Do not generally permit containers to be run with the allowPrivilegeEscalation flag set to true. Allowing this right can lead to a process running a container getting more rights than it started with. It's important to note that these rights are still constrained by the overall container sandbox, and this setting does not relate to the use of privileged containers.
extraDetail.rationale_en: A container running with the allowPrivilegeEscalation flag set to true may have processes that can gain more privileges than their parent. There should be at least one admission control policy defined which does not permit containers to allow privilege escalation. The option exists (and is defaulted to true) to permit setuid binaries to run. If you have need to run containers which use setuid binaries or require privilege escalation, this should be defined in a separate policy and you should carefully check to ensure that only limited service accounts and users are given permission to use that policy.
extraDetail.audit_en: List the policies in use for each namespace in the cluster, ensure that each policy disallows the admission of containers which allow privilege escalation.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Add policies to each namespace in the cluster which has user workloads to restrict the admission of containers with .spec.allowPrivilegeEscalationset to true.
extraDetail.impact_en: Pods defined with spec.allowPrivilegeEscalation: true will not be permitted unless they are run under a specific policy.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, there are no restrictions on contained process ability to escalate privileges, within the context of the container.

creator: default
detail_en: Minimize the admission of root containers (Manual)
detail_zh: 尽量减少根容器的进入（手动）
remediation_en:
Create a PSP as described in the Kubernetes documentation, ensuring that the
.spec.runAsUser.rule is set to either MustRunAsNonRoot or MustRunAs with the range of
UIDs not including 0.
remediation_zh: 按照Kubernetes文档中的描述创建一个PSP，确保.spec.runAsUser.rule 设置为MustRunAsNonRoot或uid范围不包括0的MustRunAs。

extraDetail.description: 通常不允许容器以 root 用户身份运行。
extraDetail.rationale: 容器可以作为任何 Linux 用户运行。以 root 用户身份运行的容器，虽然受到容器运行时安全功能的限制，但容器崩溃的可能性仍然增大。理想情况下，所有容器都应作为已定义的非 UID 0 用户运行。应至少定义一个准入控制策略不允许根容器。如果您需要运行根容器，这应该在单独的策略中定义，并且您应该仔细检查以确保只有有限的服务帐户和用户被授予使用该策略的权限。
extraDetail.audit: 列出集群中每个命名空间使用的策略，确保每个策略通过设置 MustRunAsNonRoot 或 MustRunAs 来限制根容器的使用，UID 的范围不包括 0。
extraDetail.remediation: 为集群中的每个命名空间创建一个策略，确保设置了 UID 范围不包括 0 的 MustRunAsNonRoot 或 MustRunAs。
extraDetail.impact: 不允许带有以 root 用户身份运行的容器的 Pod。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，对 root 容器的使用没有限制，如果镜像中没有指定用户，容器将以 root 身份运行。
extraDetail.description_en: Do not generally permit containers to be run as the root user.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Containers may run as any Linux user. Containers which run as the root user, whilst constrained by Container Runtime security features still have a escalated likelihood of container breakout. Ideally, all containers should run as a defined non-UID 0 user. There should be at least one admission control policy defined which does not permit root containers. If you need to run root containers, this should be defined in a separate policy and you should carefully check to ensure that only limited service accounts and users are given permission to use that policy.
extraDetail.audit_en: List the policies in use for each namespace in the cluster, ensure that each policy restricts the use of root containers by setting MustRunAsNonRoot or MustRunAs with the range of UIDs not including 0.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Create a policy for each namespace in the cluster, ensuring that either MustRunAsNonRoot or MustRunAs with the range of UIDs not including 0, is set.
extraDetail.impact_en: Pods with containers which run as the root user will not be permitted.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, there are no restrictions on the use of root containers and if a User is not specified in the image, the container will run as root.

creator: default
detail_en: Minimize the admission of containers with the NET_RAW capability (Manual)
detail_zh: 尽可能减小对拥有NET_RAW能力的容器访问
remediation_en:
Create a PSP as described in the Kubernetes documentation, ensuring that the
.spec.requiredDropCapabilities is set to include either NET_RAW or ALL.
remediation_zh: 按照Kubernetes文档中的描述创建一个PSP，确保.spec.requiredDropCapabilities 设置为包含NET_RAW或ALL。

extraDetail.description: 通常不允许容器具有潜在危险的 NET_RAW 功能。
extraDetail.rationale:
容器使用容器运行时分配的一组默认功能运行。默认情况下，这可能包括潜在的危险功能。使用 Docker 作为容器运行时，启用了 NET_RAW 功能，这可能会被恶意容器滥用。
理想情况下，所有容器都应该放弃此功能。
应该至少定义一个不允许具有 NET_RAW 功能的容器的准入控制策略。
如果你需要运行具有此功能的容器，这应该在单独的策略中定义，并且您应该仔细检查以确保只有有限的服务帐户和用户被授予使用该策略的权限。
extraDetail.audit: 列出集群中每个命名空间使用的策略，确保至少有一个策略不允许具有 NET_RAW 能力的容器进入。
extraDetail.remediation: 向集群中具有用户工作负载的每个命名空间添加策略，以限制具有 NET_RAW 能力的容器的准入。
extraDetail.impact: 不允许使用带有 NET_RAW 功能的容器的 Pod。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，使用 NET_RAW 功能创建容器没有任何限制。
extraDetail.description_en: Do not generally permit containers with the potentially dangerous NET_RAW capability.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Containers run with a default set of capabilities as assigned by the Container Runtime. By default this can include potentially dangerous capabilities. With Docker as the container runtime the NET_RAW capability is enabled which may be misused by malicious containers. Ideally, all containers should drop this capability. There should be at least one admission control policy defined which does not permit containers with the NET_RAW capability. If you need to run containers with this capability, this should be defined in a separate policy and you should carefully check to ensure that only limited service accounts and users are given permission to use that policy.
extraDetail.audit_en: List the policies in use for each namespace in the cluster, ensure that at least one policy disallows the admission of containers with the NET_RAW capability.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Add policies to each namespace in the cluster which has user workloads to restrict the admission of containers with the NET_RAW capability.
extraDetail.impact_en: Pods with containers which run with the NET_RAW capability will not be permitted.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, there are no restrictions on the creation of containers with the NET_RAW capability.

creator: default
detail_en: Minimize the admission of containers with added capabilities (Manual)
detail_zh: 最大限度地减少具有附加功能的容器（手动）
remediation_en:
Ensure that allowedCapabilities is not present in PSPs for the cluster unless
it is set to an empty array.
remediation_zh: 确保群集的PSP中不存在allowedCapabilities，除非它设置为空数组。

extraDetail.description: 通常不允许容器分配的功能超出默认设置。
extraDetail.rationale: 容器使用容器运行时分配的一组默认功能运行。可以将此集合之外的功能添加到容器中，这可能会使它们面临容器突破攻击的风险。应该至少定义一个策略来防止具有超出默认设置的功能的容器启动。如果您需要运行具有其他功能的容器，这应该在单独的策略中定义，并且您应该仔细检查以确保只有有限的服务帐户和用户被授予使用该策略的权限。
extraDetail.audit: 列出集群中每个命名空间正在使用的策略，确保存在阻止 allowedCapabilities 设置为空数组以外的任何内容的策略。
extraDetail.remediation: 确保 allowedCapabilities 不存在于集群的策略中，除非它设置为空数组。
extraDetail.impact: 不允许使用需要具有默认设置的功能的容器的 Pod。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，向容器添加功能没有任何限制。
extraDetail.description_en: Do not generally permit containers with capabilities assigned beyond the default set.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Containers run with a default set of capabilities as assigned by the Container Runtime. Capabilities outside this set can be added to containers which could expose them to risks of container breakout attacks. There should be at least one policy defined which prevents containers with capabilities beyond the default set from launching. If you need to run containers with additional capabilities, this should be defined in a separate policy and you should carefully check to ensure that only limited service accounts and users are given permission to use that policy.
extraDetail.audit_en: List the policies in use for each namespace in the cluster, ensure that policies are present which prevent allowedCapabilities to be set to anything other than an empty array.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Ensure that allowedCapabilities is not present in policies for the cluster unless it is set to an empty array.
extraDetail.impact_en: Pods with containers which require capabilities outside the default set will not be permitted.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, there are no restrictions on adding capabilities to containers.

creator: default
detail_en: Minimize the admission of containers with capabilities assigned (Manual)
detail_zh: 尽可能减少已分配能力的容器（手动）
remediation_en:
Review the use of capabilites in applications running on your cluster. Where a namespace
contains applicaions which do not require any Linux capabities to operate consider adding
a PSP which forbids the admission of containers which do not drop all capabilities.
remediation_zh:
查看在集群上运行的应用程序中使用的功能。
如果名称空间中包含不需要任何Linux功能就可以运行的应用程序，请考虑添加一个PSP，
该PSP禁止接纳没有解除所有能力的容器。

extraDetail.description: 通常不允许容器具有某些能力。
extraDetail.rationale:
容器使用容器运行时分配的一组默认功能运行。权限是 Linux 系统上通常授予 root 用户的权限的一部分。
在许多情况下，在容器中运行的应用程序不需要任何权限即可运行，因此从最小权限原则的角度来看，应尽量减少使用权限。
extraDetail.audit: 列出集群中每个命名空间使用的策略，确保至少有一个策略要求所有容器都删除功能。
extraDetail.remediation: 查看集群上运行的应用程序中功能的使用情况。如果命名空间包含不需要任何 Linux 功能来运行的应用程序，请考虑添加一个策略，该策略禁止不丢弃所有功能的容器进入。
extraDetail.impact: Pod的容器需要操作的能力是不被允许的。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，对创建具有附加功能的容器没有任何限制。
extraDetail.description_en: Do not generally permit containers with capabilities
extraDetail.rationale_en: Containers run with a default set of capabilities as assigned by the Container Runtime. Capabilities are parts of the rights generally granted on a Linux system to the root user. In many cases applications running in containers do not require any capabilities to operate, so from the perspective of the principal of least privilege use of capabilities should be minimized.
extraDetail.audit_en: List the policies in use for each namespace in the cluster, ensure that at least one policy requires that capabilities are dropped by all containers.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Review the use of capabilities in applications running on your cluster. Where a namespace contains applications which do not require any Linux capabilities to operate consider adding a policy which forbids the admission of containers which do not drop all capabilities.
extraDetail.impact_en: Pods with containers require capabilities to operate will not be permitted.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, there are no restrictions on the creation of containers with additional capabilities

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the CNI in use supports Network Policies (Manual)
detail_zh: 确保使用中的CNI支持网络策略（手动）
remediation_en:
If the CNI plugin in use does not support network policies, consideration should be given to
making use of a different plugin, or finding an alternate mechanism for restricting traffic
in the Kubernetes cluster.
remediation_zh:
如果使用中的CNI插件不支持网络策略，则应考虑使用不同的插件，
或找到另一种机制来限制Kubernetes集群中的流量。

extraDetail.description: 有多种可用于 Kubernetes 的 CNI 插件。如果使用的 CNI 不支持网络策略，则可能无法有效限制集群中的流量。
extraDetail.rationale: Kubernetes 网络策略由使用中的 CNI 插件强制执行。因此，确保 CNI 插件同时支持 Ingress 和 Egress 网络策略非常重要。
extraDetail.audit: 查看集群使用的 CNI 插件的文档，并确认它支持 Ingress 和 Egress 网络策略。
extraDetail.remediation: 如果使用的 CNI 插件不支持网络策略，则应考虑使用不同的插件，或寻找替代机制来限制 Kubernetes 集群中的流量。
extraDetail.impact: 无。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 这将取决于使用的 CNI 插件。
extraDetail.description_en: There are a variety of CNI plugins available for Kubernetes. If the CNI in use does not support Network Policies it may not be possible to effectively restrict traffic in the cluster.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Kubernetes network policies are enforced by the CNI plugin in use. As such it is important to ensure that the CNI plugin supports both Ingress and Egress network policies.
extraDetail.audit_en: Review the documentation of CNI plugin in use by the cluster, and confirm that it supports Ingress and Egress network policies.
extraDetail.remediation_en: If the CNI plugin in use does not support network policies, consideration should be given to making use of a different plugin, or finding an alternate mechanism for restricting traffic in the Kubernetes cluster.
extraDetail.impact_en: None
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: This will depend on the CNI plugin in use.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that all Namespaces have Network Policies defined (Manual)
detail_zh: 确保所有命名空间都定义了网络策略（手动）
remediation_en: Follow the documentation and create NetworkPolicy objects as you need them.
remediation_zh: 按照文档操作并根据需要创建NetworkPolicy对象。

extraDetail.description: 使用网络策略隔离集群网络中的流量。
extraDetail.rationale:
在同一个 Kubernetes 集群上运行不同的应用程序会产生一个受感染的应用程序攻击相邻应用程序的风险。网络分段对于确保容器只能与它们应该进行的通信非常重要。
网络策略是关于如何允许选择的 pod 相互通信以及与其他网络端点通信的规范。网络策略是命名空间范围的。将网络策略引入给定命名空间时，该策略不允许的所有流量都会被拒绝。但是，如果命名空间中没有网络策略，则所有流量都将被允许进出该命名空间中的 Pod。
extraDetail.audit:
运行以下命令并查看在集群中创建的 NetworkPolicy 对象。
kubectl --all-namespaces get networkpolicy

确保集群中定义的每个命名空间至少有一个网络策略。
extraDetail.remediation: 遵循文档并根据需要创建 NetworkPolicy 对象。
extraDetail.impact: 一旦网络策略在给定的命名空间中使用，网络策略未明确允许的流量将被拒绝。因此，重要的是要确保在引入网络策略时不会阻止合法流量。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，不创建网络策略。
extraDetail.description_en: Use network policies to isolate traffic in your cluster network.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Running different applications on the same Kubernetes cluster creates a risk of one compromised application attacking a neighboring application. Network segmentation is important to ensure that containers can communicate only with those they are supposed to. A network policy is a specification of how selections of pods are allowed to communicate with each other and other network endpoints. Network Policies are namespace scoped. When a network policy is introduced to a given namespace, all traffic not allowed by the policy is denied. However, if there are no network policies in a namespace all traffic will be allowed into and out of the pods in that namespace.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the below command and review the NetworkPolicy objects created in the cluster. kubectl --all-namespaces get networkpolicy Ensure that each namespace defined in the cluster has at least one Network Policy.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Follow the documentation and create NetworkPolicy objects as you need them.
extraDetail.impact_en: Once network policies are in use within a given namespace, traffic not explicitly allowed by a network policy will be denied. As such it is important to ensure that, when introducing network policies, legitimate traffic is not blocked.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, network policies are not created.

creator: default
detail_en: Prefer using secrets as files over secrets as environment variables (Manual)
detail_zh: 选择使用secrets作为文件而不是secrets作为环境变量（手动）
remediation_en:
if possible, rewrite application code to read secrets from mounted secret files, rather than
from environment variables.
remediation_zh: 如果可能，重写应用程序代码以从装载的secrets文件中读取敏感信息，而不是从环境变量中读取。

extraDetail.description: Kubernetes 支持将 Secrets 挂载为数据卷或环境变量。尽量减少环境变量 Secrets 的使用。
extraDetail.rationale: 应用程序代码记录其环境到日志中是相当常见的（尤其是在发生错误时）。这将包括作为环境变量传入的任何 Secret 值，因此 Secret 可以很容易地暴露给任何有权访问日志的用户或实体。
extraDetail.audit:
运行以下命令以查找对使用从 Secret 定义的环境变量的对象的引用。
kubectl get all -o jsonpath='{range .items[?(@..secretKeyRef)]} {.kind} {.metadata.name} {"\n"}{end}' -A
extraDetail.remediation: 如果可能，重写应用程序代码以从已挂载的 Secret 文件中读取 Secret ，而不是从环境变量中读取Secret。
extraDetail.impact: 期望以环境变量形式读取 Secret 的应用程序代码需要修改。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，未定义 Secret。
extraDetail.description_en: Kubernetes supports mounting secrets as data volumes or as environment variables. Minimize the use of environment variable secrets.
extraDetail.rationale_en: It is reasonably common for application code to log out its environment (particularly in the event of an error). This will include any secret values passed in as environment variables, so secrets can easily be exposed to any user or entity who has access to the logs.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command to find references to objects which use environment variables defined from secrets. kubectl get all -o jsonpath='{range .items[?(@..secretKeyRef)]} {.kind} {.metadata.name} {"\n"}{end}' -A
extraDetail.remediation_en: If possible, rewrite application code to read secrets from mounted secret files, rather than from environment variables.
extraDetail.impact_en: Application code which expects to read secrets in the form of environment variables would need modification
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, secrets are not defined

creator: default
detail_en: Consider external secret storage (Manual)
detail_zh: 考虑外部敏感信息存储（手动）
remediation_en:
Refer to the secrets management options offered by your cloud provider or a third-party
secrets management solution.
remediation_zh: 请参阅云提供商或第三方机密管理解决方案提供的secrets管理选项

extraDetail.description: 如果您有更复杂的 Secret 管理需求，请考虑使用外部 Secret 存储和管理系统，而不是直接使用 Kubernetes Secret。确保解决方案需要身份验证才能访问 Secret，对 Secret 的访问和使用进行审计，并对 Secret 进行加密。一些解决方案还可以更轻松地轮换 Secret。
extraDetail.rationale: Kubernetes 支持 Secret 作为一等对象，但需要注意确保对 Secret 的访问受到严格限制。使用外部Secret 提供程序可以简化对 Secret 访问的管理，尤其是在 Kubernetes 和非 Kubernetes 环境中使用Secret 的情况下。
extraDetail.audit: 查看您的 Secret 管理实现。
extraDetail.remediation: 请参阅您的云提供商或第三方 Secret 管理解决方案提供的 Secret 管理选项。
extraDetail.impact: 无。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，未配置外部 Secret 管理。
extraDetail.description_en: Consider the use of an external secrets storage and management system, instead of using Kubernetes Secrets directly, if you have more complex secret management needs. Ensure the solution requires authentication to access secrets, has auditing of access to and use of secrets, and encrypts secrets. Some solutions also make it easier to rotate secrets.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Kubernetes supports secrets as first-class objects, but care needs to be taken to ensure that access to secrets is carefully limited. Using an external secrets provider can ease the management of access to secrets, especially where secrets are used across both Kubernetes and non-Kubernetes environments.
extraDetail.audit_en: Review your secrets management implementation.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Refer to the secrets management options offered by your cloud provider or a third-party secrets management solution.
extraDetail.impact_en: None
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, no external secret management is configured.

creator: default
detail_en: Configure Image Provenance using ImagePolicyWebhook admission controller (Manual)
detail_zh: 使用ImagePolicyWebhook许可控制器配置镜像来源（手动）
remediation_en: Follow the Kubernetes documentation and setup image provenance.
remediation_zh: 遵循Kubernetes文档并设置镜像来源。

extraDetail.description: 为您的 deployment 配置镜像源。
extraDetail.rationale: Kubernetes 支持插入出处规则以接受或拒绝 deployment 中的镜像。您可以配置此类规则以确保仅在集群中部署被允许的镜像。
extraDetail.audit: 查看集群中的 pod 定义并验证是否已适当配置镜像源。
extraDetail.remediation: 遵循 Kubernetes 文档并设置镜像源。
extraDetail.impact: 您需要根据容器镜像的更新定期维护您的源配置。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，未设置镜像源。
extraDetail.description_en: Configure Image Provenance for your deployment.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Kubernetes supports plugging in provenance rules to accept or reject the images in your deployments. You could configure such rules to ensure that only approved images are deployed in the cluster.
extraDetail.audit_en: Review the pod definitions in your cluster and verify that image provenance is configured as appropriate.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Follow the Kubernetes documentation and setup image provenance.
extraDetail.impact_en: You need to regularly maintain your provenance configuration based on container image updates.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, image provenance is not set.

creator: default
detail_en: Create administrative boundaries between resources using namespaces (Manual)
detail_zh: 使用命名空间在资源之间创建管理边界（手动）
remediation_en:
Follow the documentation and create namespaces for objects in your deployment as you need
them.
remediation_zh: 按照文档操作，并根据需要为部署中的对象创建命名空间。

extraDetail.description: 使用命名空间来隔离您的 Kubernetes 对象。
extraDetail.rationale: 限制用户权限的范围可以减少错误或恶意活动的影响。 Kubernetes 命名空间允许您将创建的资源划分为逻辑命名的组。在一个命名空间中创建的资源可以对其他命名空间隐藏。默认情况下，用户在 Kubernetes 集群中创建的每个资源都运行在默认命名空间中，称为 default。您可以创建其他命名空间并将资源和用户附加到它们。您可以使用 Kubernetes 授权插件来创建策略，在不同用户之间隔离对命名空间资源的访问。
extraDetail.audit:
运行以下命令并查看集群中创建的命名空间。
kubectl get namespaces

确保这些命名空间是您需要的，并且根据您的要求得到充分管理。
extraDetail.remediation: 遵循文档并根据需要为部署中的对象创建命名空间。
extraDetail.impact: 您需要在命名空间之间切换以进行管理。
extraDetail.defaultValue:
默认情况下，Kubernetes 以四个初始命名空间开始：
1. default：没有其他命名空间的对象的默认命名空间
2. kube-system：Kubernetes系统创建的对象的命名空间
3. kube-node-lease：用于节点心跳的命名空间
4. kube-public：用于集群中公共信息的命名空间
extraDetail.description_en: Use namespaces to isolate your Kubernetes objects.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Limiting the scope of user permissions can reduce the impact of mistakes or malicious activities. A Kubernetes namespace allows you to partition created resources into logically named groups. Resources created in one namespace can be hidden from other namespaces. By default, each resource created by a user in Kubernetes cluster runs in a default namespace, called default. You can create additional namespaces and attach resources and users to them. You can use Kubernetes Authorization plugins to create policies that segregate access to namespace resources between different users.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the below command and review the namespaces created in the cluster. kubectl get namespaces Ensure that these namespaces are the ones you need and are adequately administered as per your requirements.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Follow the documentation and create namespaces for objects in your deployment as you need them.
extraDetail.impact_en: You need to switch between namespaces for administration.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, Kubernetes starts with two initial namespaces: 1. default - The default namespace for objects with no other namespace 2. kube-system - The namespace for objects created by the Kubernetes system 3. kube-node-lease - Namespace used for node heartbeats 4. kube-public - Namespace used for public information in a cluster

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the seccomp profile is set to docker/default in your pod definitions (Manual)
detail_zh: 确保在pod定义中将seccomp配置文件设置为docker/default(手动)
remediation_en:
Seccomp is an alpha feature currently. By default, all alpha features are disabled. So, you
would need to enable alpha features in the apiserver by passing "--feature-
gates=AllAlpha=true" argument.
Edit the /etc/kubernetes/apiserver file on the master node and set the KUBE_API_ARGS
parameter to "--feature-gates=AllAlpha=true"
KUBE_API_ARGS="--feature-gates=AllAlpha=true"
Based on your system, restart the kube-apiserver service. For example:
systemctl restart kube-apiserver.service
Use annotations to enable the docker/default seccomp profile in your pod definitions. An
example is as below:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: trustworthy-pod
  annotations:
    seccomp.security.alpha.kubernetes.io/pod: docker/default
spec:
  containers:
    - name: trustworthy-container
      image: sotrustworthy:latest
remediation_zh:
Seccomp目前是alpha特性。默认情况下，将禁用所有alpha功能。因此，你
需要在apiserver中通过传递"--feature-gates=AllAlpha=true"参数来启用alpha特性。
在主节点上编辑/etc/kubernetes/apiserver文件并设置KUBE_API_ARGS参数为
"--feature-gates=AllAlpha=true"
KUBE_API_ARGS="--feature-gates=AllAlpha=true"
根据您的系统，重新启动kube-apiserver服务。例如：
systemctl restart kube-apiserver.service
使用注释在pod定义中启用docker/default seccomp配置文件。
一个示例如下：
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: trustworthy-pod
  annotations:
    seccomp.security.alpha.kubernetes.io/pod: docker/default
spec:
  containers:
    - name: trustworthy-container
      image: sotrustworthy:latest

extraDetail.description: 在 pod 定义中启用 docker/default seccomp 配置文件。
extraDetail.rationale: Seccomp（安全计算模式）用于限制应用程序可以进行的系统调用集，允许集群管理员更好地控制集群中运行的工作负载的安全性。由于历史原因，Kubernetes 默认禁用 seccomp 配置文件。您应该启用它以确保工作负载在容器中具有可用的受限操作。
extraDetail.audit:
查看集群中的 pod 定义。它应该创建如下一行：
securityContext:
  seccompProfile:
    type: RuntimeDefault
extraDetail.remediation:
使用安全上下文在您的 pod 定义中启用 docker/default seccomp 配置文件。例如：
securityContext:
  seccompProfile:
    type: RuntimeDefault
extraDetail.impact: 如果 docker/default seccomp 配置文件对您来说过于严格，您将不得不创建/管理您自己的 seccomp 配置文件。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，seccomp 配置文件设置为 unconfined，这意味着没有启用任何 seccomp 配置文件。
extraDetail.description_en: Enable docker/default seccomp profile in your pod definitions.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Seccomp (secure computing mode) is used to restrict the set of system calls applications can make, allowing cluster administrators greater control over the security of workloads running in the cluster. Kubernetes disables seccomp profiles by default for historical reasons. You should enable it to ensure that the workloads have restricted actions available within the container.
extraDetail.audit_en: Review the pod definitions in your cluster. It should create a line as below:   securityContext:     seccompProfile:       type: RuntimeDefault
extraDetail.remediation_en: Use security context to enable the docker/default seccomp profile in your pod definitions. An example is as below:   securityContext:     seccompProfile:       type: RuntimeDefault
extraDetail.impact_en: If the docker/default seccomp profile is too restrictive for you, you would have to create/manage your own seccomp profiles.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, seccomp profile is set to unconfined which means that no seccomp profiles are enabled.

creator: default
detail_en: Apply Security Context to Your Pods and Containers (Manual)
detail_zh: 对pod和容器应用Security Context（手动）
remediation_en:
Follow the Kubernetes documentation and apply security contexts to your pods. For a
suggested list of security contexts, you may refer to the CIS Security Benchmark for Docker
Containers.
remediation_zh: 遵循Kubernetes文档并将security contexts应用于pods。有关security contexts的建议列表，您可以参考Docker容器的CIS安全基准。

extraDetail.description: 将安全上下文应用于您的 Pod 和容器
extraDetail.rationale: 安全上下文定义了应用于容器的操作系统安全设置（uid、gid、功能、SELinux 角色等）。在设计容器和 Pod 时，请确保为 Pod、容器和卷配置安全上下文。安全上下文是部署 yaml 中定义的属性。它控制将分配给 pod/container/volume 的安全参数。有两个级别的安全上下文：pod 级别的安全上下文和容器级别的安全上下文。
extraDetail.audit: 查看集群中的 pod 定义并验证您是否定义了适当的安全上下文。
extraDetail.remediation: 遵循 Kubernetes 文档并将安全上下文应用到您的 pod。有关安全上下文的建议列表，您可以参考 Docker 容器的 CIS 安全基准。
extraDetail.impact: 如果您错误地应用了安全上下文，您可能无法运行 pod。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，不会自动将安全上下文应用于 pod。
extraDetail.description_en: Apply Security Context to Your Pods and Containers
extraDetail.rationale_en: A security context defines the operating system security settings (uid, gid, capabilities, SELinux role, etc..) applied to a container. When designing your containers and pods, make sure that you configure the security context for your pods, containers, and volumes. A security context is a property defined in the deployment yaml. It controls the security parameters that will be assigned to the pod/container/volume. There are two levels of security context: pod level security context, and container level security context.
extraDetail.audit_en: Review the pod definitions in your cluster and verify that you have security contexts defined as appropriate.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Follow the Kubernetes documentation and apply security contexts to your pods. For a suggested list of security contexts, you may refer to the CIS Security Benchmark for Docker Containers.
extraDetail.impact_en: If you incorrectly apply security contexts, you may have trouble running the pods.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, no security contexts are automatically applied to pods.

creator: default
detail_en: The default namespace should not be used (Manual)
detail_zh: 不应使用默认命名空间（手动）
remediation_en:
Ensure that namespaces are created to allow for appropriate segregation of Kubernetes
resources and that all new resources are created in a specific namespace.
remediation_zh: 确保创建的名称空间允许Kubernetes资源的适当分离，并且所有新资源都在特定的名称空间中创建。

extraDetail.description: Kubernetes 提供了一个默认的命名空间，如果没有为它们指定命名空间，则将对象放置在其中。将对象放置在此命名空间中会使 RBAC 和其他控件的应用更加困难。
extraDetail.rationale: Kubernetes 集群中的资源应按命名空间进行隔离，以允许在该级别应用安全控制并更容易管理资源。
extraDetail.audit: 运行此命令以列出默认命名空间中的对象：kubectl get all。唯一的条目应该是系统管理的资源，例如 Kubernetes 服务。
extraDetail.remediation: 确保创建命名空间以允许对 Kubernetes 资源进行适当的隔离，并确保在特定命名空间中创建所有新资源。
extraDetail.impact: 无。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 除非命名空间特定于对象创建，否则将使用默认命名空间。
extraDetail.description_en: Kubernetes provides a default namespace, where objects are placed if no namespace is specified for them. Placing objects in this namespace makes application of RBAC and other controls more difficult.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Resources in a Kubernetes cluster should be segregated by namespace, to allow for security controls to be applied at that level and to make it easier to manage resources.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run this command to list objects in default namespace kubectl get $(kubectl api-resources --verbs=list --namespaced=true -o name | paste -sd, -) --ignore-not-found -n default The only entries there should be system managed resources such as the kubernetes service
extraDetail.remediation_en: Ensure that namespaces are created to allow for appropriate segregation of Kubernetes resources and that all new resources are created in a specific namespace.
extraDetail.impact_en: None
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: Unless a namespace is specific on object creation, the default namespace will be used
